# V76-V89: nine behavioral response mechanisms

Nine single-family ablations and five combinations on the locked frozen Kumo Large90 + correction12 + spline77. Original5fold seed31027;50k context/6k correction/14k validation per fold. Frozen Kumo and original spline unchanged. New features enter the correction branch only.

| ID | Method | L2 | Inference strength |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| V76 | Shrunk marginal income-outflow response and lag1 | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V77 | Shrunk asymmetric upside/downside income response | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V78 | Post-rejection loan-request adaptation | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V79 | Loan-normalized DPD15 installment-size response | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V80 | Daily spending/order spectral fingerprint | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V81 | One-to-one cancelled-to-completed recovery | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V82 | Historical approved/requested rationing trajectory | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V83 | Underwriting elapsed-time friction | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V84 | Multiscale normalized Allan variance | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V85 | Combined income response and asymmetry | 0.01 | 0.5 |
| V86 | Combined spectral and multiscale variability | 0.01 | 0.5 |
| V87 | Combined credit reapplication and rationing | 0.01 | 0.5 |
| V88 | All eight non-DPD behavior mechanisms conservative | 0.03 | 0.25 |
| V89 | All nine behavior mechanisms including allowed DPD | 0.03 | 0.25 |

## Formulas and availability

MPC: dx=Delta income_like_credits/own median positive observed income, dy=Delta outflows/same scale; centered Sxx=sum((dx-mean(dx))^2), Sxy=sum((dx-mean(dx))*(dy-mean(dy))). Posterior response=(Sxy+lambda*population_slope)/(Sxx+lambda). Uncertainty=sqrt(population_residual_variance/(Sxx+lambda)). Savings capture=1-response. Lag1 uses dx_t versus dy_(t+1) on contiguous month triples. At least3 changes; no causal MPC claim.

Asymmetry: dy=intercept+beta_up*max(dx,0)+beta_down*min(dx,0). Center the sufficient statistics to leave intercept unpenalized. beta=inv(centered_Gram+lambda*I)*(centered_rhs+lambda*population_beta). Response gap=beta_up-beta_down; variance from inverse penalized information. Require >=2 positive and2 negative changes.

Population priors for both response models and rejection-approval smoothing use correction customers only, strictly earlier selected-decision months, with three inner folds excluding the training query customer. Sparse dated populations have explicit fixed fallbacks. No default labels enter references.

Reapplication: adjacent historical applications only; prior rejection decision must precede next application submission. Concession=1-next_requested/rejected_requested; escalation=1[next_requested>rejected_requested]; waiting days=next_application-prior_decision. Thirty-day reapplication rate requires full30d follow-up. Approval after concession is Beta-Binomial-smoothed using eligible historical next decisions only.

Installment-size response: mature15d historical installments; y=1[maxDPD>=15], x=log(amount_due/own median historical due). Each historical loan contributes total weighted-binomial exposure1. Individual intercept/slope use a Gaussian penalty toward the dated population coefficients. Require >=2 historical loans and distinct amounts. Save slope, P90-P10 log-odds contrast, slope SD, and extrapolation to the new proposed installment. This is a propensity for historical delinquency, not calibrated future-default probability.

DPD is allowed without quarantine by explicit instruction: "jangan karantina dpd". Snapshot provenance remains unresolved. Existing scores, predictions and submission bytes are unchanged; historical classification is retained in original RESULT.json and current policy is applied in effective reports. This instruction does not prove source availability.

Spectral:180full calendar days ending before the incomplete decision day; completed unique-order spend and counts. Linear detrend, Hann taper, rFFT squared magnitude, power normalized by total nonzero-frequency power. Period bands6-8d,12-16d,25-35d; peak period3-90d. Require >=8 completed orders and an observed event predating the full window. First event is a coverage proxy, not proven platform enrollment.

Cancellation recovery: cancelled anchors in90d with full7d follow-up; match one later completed order at most once, within7d, category-mask Jaccard>=0.5, nominal difference<=25%. Chronological deterministic greedy matching. Recovery shares within1/3/7d, mean matched delay and eligible-event count. No inference about cancellation reasons or exact item replacement.

Rationing: rho=approved_amount/requested_amount on historical approved applications. Last-first rho change, OLS rho/time slope per180d with >=30d span, latest rho and support count. Approved-only selection and changing loan requests confound institutional credit-supply interpretation.

Friction: decision_datetime-application_datetime in minutes. Historical median, last-first change, approval-minus-rejection median, selected duration minus own historical median. Nonnegative checks execute; report min/max/unique counts. Workflow artifacts remain possible; no underwriting-risk interpretation from delay alone.

Allan: Avar(tau)=0.5*mean((adjacent nonoverlapping tau-day block means difference)^2)/mean(daily_spend)^2, tau1/7/14; >=4 blocks. Weekly/daily and fortnight/daily ratios; same fixed180-full-day exposure and transaction-support rules as spectral. Constant positive series gives zero, zero denominator remains missing.

## Records and execution

Each completed experiment produces METHOD.json, REPORT.md, RESULT.json, OOF.csv, five correction checkpoints and its own hashed30k-row submission CSV. Report KS, AUC, paired fold/class-stratified bootstrap300 CIs and deltas, per-fold direction, training/validation gap, parameters and overfitting risk. Negative results stay in the registry. CIs are conditional on fitted scores and uncorrected for repeated search/retraining. No automatic promotion or competition submission.

Raw extraction overlaps V60-V75; model jobs wait for STATISTICAL_QUEUE completion, then run two CPU workers. Status: v7/reports/BEHAVIOR_QUEUE.json. Sources: v7/scripts/behavior_features.py and run_behavior_queue.py. Feature catalog: v7/behavior/reports/FEATURE_CATALOG.csv.

| V97 | Cross-fitted historical approval propensity residual | 0.003 | 0.5 |
| V98 | Early payment and lifecycle combined | 0.01 | 0.5 |
| V99 | Combined historical auxiliary-model residuals | 0.01 | 0.5 |
| V100 | All seven lifecycle mechanisms conservative | 0.03 | 0.25 |
| V101 | Lifecycle mechanisms excluding auxiliary classifiers | 0.03 | 0.25 |

## Definitions and auxiliary models

The complete implementation-ready feature list is v7/lifecycle/reports/FEATURE_CATALOG.csv. Every definition, including first-payment shortfall and non-improving features, is retained in EXPERIMENT_MASTER_LOG.md/json/csv.

First observed installment is assigned by due_date within each historical loan; ambiguous duplicate due dates trigger failure. Opaque IDs are not numeric predictors. Contractual installment1 is not certified by observed ordering. First3 DPD15 uses due-age>=15; first/early-vs-late severity/shortfall uses age>=30. Missing/zero denominators remain missing.

MOB_at_due=(due_year-origin_year)*12+due_month-origin_month. Historical approval decision is an explicit origination proxy. Phase=MOB/tenor: early<=1/3, middle<=2/3, late>2/3. Cross-phase change is computed within loan and requires both phases. Calendar due-age is separately computed from selected cutoff; it is not MOB.

Seasoning reference cells: MOB bins<=3/6/9/12/>12, tenor, origin vintage halfyear, due-age bins<=30/60/90/180/>180. Cell expected outcome=(weighted_event_sum+20*dated_population_mean)/(weighted_exposure+20). Cohorts use appropriately mature15/30d installments. Severity is min(maxDPD,90)/90; no simultaneous unconstrained full age-period-cohort parameter decomposition is claimed. Residual=observed-expected; aggregate equally across loans.

Auxiliary repayment classifier predicts historical DPD15 using log1p(amount_due), contractual APR, tenor, MOB/tenor, log1p(observation due age), origin vintage month and due-month sine/cosine. Approval classifier predicts approved versus rejected from historical log1p(requested amount), tenor, application calendar period and month sine/cosine. Exclude cancelled requests, selected target/profile, approved_amount, loan_id and approval-only APR from approval predictors.

Both classifiers are HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=50,max_leaf_nodes=7,min_samples_leaf=80,l2_regularization=20,learning_rate=.05,early_stopping=False,random_state=31027). Sparse<100-row/one-class references use explicit smoothed constant probabilities. Empty dated repayment/approval references use0.15/0.5 respectively. Repayment weights give each observed loan total exposure1.

For every query selected-decision month, reference customers must belong to correction training and have their own selected snapshot cutoff strictly before that month. Three inner customer folds exclude the training query. Neither outer validation/test nor selected-loan default labels train auxiliaries. These are peer benchmarks available at the selected cutoff, not reconstructed scores at old historical decision/due dates.

Repayment residual features: mean/P90(y15-p), unexpected good y15=0 with p>=.5, unexpected bad y15=1 with p<.15, and conditional noise proxy sqrt(loan-equal mean(p*(1-p))/eligible loan count). Approval residual is observed approval minus predicted probability. These uncertainties are not cluster-robust confidence intervals.

Thin-file signature combines previous/repayment/account source availability with absent/unscored/scored bureau states as a categorical string. Add internal history age, mature installment count, repayment calendar density, bureau report density and observed account-calendar coverage. Missing sources do not prove new-to-credit. Complete account months only; available_datetime<=cutoff for bureau.

Bureau scenarios use latest available/provider max debt, summed reported debt, their gap, relative gap and debt/income ratios. These are observed-report scenario proxies; overlapping accounts, different report times and missing accounts prevent guaranteed true debt bounds.

DPD is used without quarantine per user instruction. DPD and amount_paid source snapshot uncertainty remains recorded; inclusion does not certify provenance. Original locked predictions/checkpoints/CSV are preserved.

## Matched evaluation and records

V90 adds exactly the same four common history-support columns and no family-specific features. Each V91-V101 gets paired KS/AUC comparison against V90 as well as the locked baseline. Source formulas, model settings, all fold scores, bootstrap300 conditional CIs, overfit diagnostics, checkpoints, OOF and individual submission CSV are retained even when performance worsens. No repeated-search correction or independent temporal/seed validation is implied.

Raw extraction overlaps preceding work. Model fits wait for BEHAVIOR_QUEUE completion and run two CPU workers. Controller supports adopting an already running feature worker. Status LIFECYCLE_QUEUE.json.

## Automatic master log

v7/scripts/master_log.py --watch rebuilds EXPERIMENT_MASTER_LOG.md/json/csv in v7/reports every30seconds. It reads every result/status, active and archived catalogs, source method documents and archived result records. No filtering on gain. Unavailable metrics/formulas are explicitly marked. Archives are not resumed. Each canonical source is recorded with SHA256; original result files remain unchanged.

# Cross-loan repayment and observation opportunity

Batch keempat V42–V59 menambah18 eksperimen sesudah42 sebelumnya. Baseline public0.56470 tetap terkunci; backbone Kumo Large90 **100% frozen**, context50k, correction-training6k, validation14k dan lima fold asli tetap sama. Cabang spline77 dan campuran75:25 tetap. Fitur ditambahkan ke head koreksi dari raw cached Kumo, bukan melatih ulang backbone atau mengganti baseline secara diam-diam.

| ID | Pengujian |
|---|---|
| V42 | Scheduled due crowding + multi-loan exposure |
| V43 | Liquidity mismatch pada bulan due yang sama |
| V44 | Dispersion dan pola waktu last allocation |
| V45 | Bureau availability latency dan perbedaan provider |
| V46 | Urutan observed delayed allocations lintas-loan |
| V47 | Persaingan kewajiban dengan snapshot amount_paid |
| V48 | Selective repayment dan priority inversion |
| V49 | Due-cohort synchrony dan current severe loan count |
| V50 | Next-other-loan due-cohort lateness association |
| V51 | Entropy alokasi kumulatif versus scheduled due exposure |
| V52 | Kontrol maturity exposure15/30/60/90, tanpa label DPD baru |
| V53 | Matured DPD raw rates + EB posterior/SD + exposure yang sama |
| V54 | Matured amount-weighted DPD + exposure yang sama |
| V55 | Spending/order burst0–7 versus7–14 hari sebelum due |
| V56 | Pre-due spending dibandingkan menurut eventual-by-cutoff DPD15 |
| V57 | Gabungan incremental features tanpa DPD/amount_paid baru |
| V58 | Gabungan snapshot-dependent features, L2 .03 shrink .25 |
| V59 | Seluruh mekanisme baru, L2 .03 shrink .25 |

V42–V56 memakai L2 .003 dan shrink .5. V57 memakai L2 .01 dan shrink .5. Parameter ditetapkan sebelum melihat hasil. V47–V51, V53/V54/V56/V58/V59 ditandai snapshot-dependent dan tidak dipromosikan otomatis. Snapshot field spesifik dicatat: amount_paid berbeda dari DPD. Semua kandidat tetap mewarisi ketidakpastian snapshot/global reference baseline.

## Definisi yang dijaga

`Selective repayment` adalah proporsi **bulan jatuh tempo** multi-loan dengan campuran loan-month cohort lunas dan belum lunas, keduanya diukur **pada selected cutoff**. Ini bukan status pembayaran pada historical month-end dan bukan bukti preferensi. Priority inversion membandingkan pasangan ukuran scheduled due yang berbeda dalam due month yang sama dan paid/due coverage pada cutoff.

Due-cohort synchrony berarti beberapa loan dari due month yang sama pernah mencapai maxDPD30 **sampai selected cutoff**. Itu tidak membuktikan tanggal mulai keterlambatannya bersamaan. Current severe loan count memang memakai snapshot selected cutoff yang sama, tetap dengan provenance belum terverifikasi.

Data tidak punya threshold-crossing timestamps atau seluruh payment ledger. Karena itu tidak dibuat klaim exact failure contagion. Versi timestamp mengukur keterkelompokan **delayed last-allocation events** lintas-loan dengan full30d follow-up. Versi DPD mengukur hubungan label cutoff pada adjacent other-loan due cohorts, bukan propagation atau causation. Mekanisme exact yang tidak tersedia dicatat di FEATURE_STATUS.json.

Entropy memakai cumulative amount_paid per loan pada cutoff, minimal dua loan dan positive total payment. Exposure dikendalikan dengan divergence terhadap distribusi cumulative amount_due. Total payment nol menghasilkan undefined entropy, bukan otomatis nol.

## Maturity exposure

Umur cicilan memakai selisih **tanggal kalender lokal** normalized due dan decision. Untuk setiap threshold15/30/60/90, denominator hanya cicilan dengan umur>=threshold. Raw rate, jumlah exposure, exposure/all-history ratio, amount-weighted rate dan Beta-Binomial posterior/SD terpisah. Prior hanya dipasang pada6k correction-training, tanpa default target. Undefined raw rate tetap missing; posterior pada n=0 merupakan prior populasi dan didampingi exposure0.

Rate per threshold mempunyai eligible cohorts berbeda. Jangan menjadikannya satu survival curve tanpa denominator bersama. Serial dependence dalam cicilan dapat membuat uncertainty posterior optimistis. V53/V54 dibandingkan secara khusus dengan V52 agar pengaruh delinquency dapat dipisahkan dari kedalaman histori.

## Scheduling, liquidity, ecommerce dan bureau

Crowding memakai maximum scheduled amount dalam rolling7 calendar days relatif median monthly due atau declared income pada last180d. Ini tidak memakai outcome. Liquidity memakai gross monthly income atau opening_balance+inflows pada complete account month yang sama. Tidak mengurangi scheduled debt lagi dari net CF yang mungkin sudah memuat pembayaran lama. Partial account visibility tetap batasan.

Timing menggunakan last allocation, bukan settlement. Account months lengkap, previous decisions dan allocations harus sebelum selected cutoff; bureau reports harus available<=cutoff. Snapshot maxDPD/paid konsisten pada audit tetapi belum mempunyai provenance independen.

Pre-due orders memakai cache order-level yang sudah diaudit, completed only. Setiap order dipasangkan dengan satu next historical due dalam14d. Exposure0–7 dan7–14 dibatasi jarak dari due sebelumnya agar overlapping windows tidak dihitung ganda. Duedate sebelum window180d tetap diperhitungkan saat ownership dan exposure di batas window. Label eventual DPD hanya di antara due-age>=15. Tidak ada klaim transaksi tersebut menyebabkan keterlambatan.

Bureau latency adalah available_datetime−report_datetime, dengan last-report-per-provider dan same-provider changes. Provider delay dapat mencerminkan proses pelaporan; seluruh balances/counts tidak dijumlahkan antar-provider.

## Eksekusi dan penyimpanan

Ekstraksi boleh berjalan paralel dengan batch discovery. Model queue menunggu batch sebelumnya selesai, memakai dua worker CPU dan cached frozen-Kumo scores. Setiap percobaan menyimpan submission30k, OOF70k, lima checkpoint koreksi, feature/prior provenance, KS/AUC, per-fold wins, logloss/Brier dan paired CI. AUC CI dan AUC fold wins ikut masuk experiment registry.

Bootstrap300 resamples berpasangan fold/class bersifat conditional pada prediksi yang sudah difit, bukan selection-corrected dan tidak memuat retraining uncertainty. Fold telah berulang digunakan; tidak ada untouched holdout. Baseline tidak diganti hanya karena highest pooled OOF. CSV baru tidak mewarisi skor public baseline.

# Basket, event alignment, underwriting tier and credit maturity

Batch ketiga V26–V41 menambah16 eksperimen di atas26 hasil sebelumnya. Baseline tetap frozen Kumo Large90 + koreksi12 fitur + spline77, dengan bobot75:25 dan shrink logit .5. Public0.56470 hanya milik CSV yang dikunci; semua kandidat baru belum punya skor public.

Fitur baru diuji pada **koreksi offset** dari raw cached Kumo score; backbone dan spline tetap. Tidak menumpuk model koreksi di atas prediksi koreksi yang in-sample. Lima fold,50.000 context,6.000 correction-training dan14.000 validation tetap identik. Preprocessing koreksi dipasang pada correction-training saja.

| ID | Ablation |
|---|---|
| V26 | Item count, quantity, category count, item-value concentration, perubahan kompleksitas30d |
| V27 | Kombinasi kategori dalam basket, rarity, pair lift, personal novelty, entropy kombinasi |
| V28 | Anomali unit price relatif histori customer–category yang lebih lama |
| V29 | Spending dan lima metode pembayaran sebelum/sesudah approval/rejection |
| V30 | Spending sekitar due date lama, dengan nearest-event ownership dan exposure hari |
| V31 | Probabilitas tier bunga aktual, surprise, expected gap, uncertainty |
| V32 | Transisi bunga dari pinjaman historis terakhir |
| V33 | Estimasi maturity, jarak waktu dan scheduled burden mendekati akhir tenor |
| V34 | Maturity × rolling inquiry count/net change × credit demand |
| V35 | Gabungan basket |
| V36 | Gabungan event alignment |
| V37 | Gabungan underwriting |
| V38 | Seluruh fitur baru tanpa turunan DPD baru, L2 .03 dan shrink .25 |
| V39 | Underwriting + maturity/credit cycle |
| V40 | Pricing tier dikondisikan DPD, provenance belum terverifikasi |
| V41 | Gabungan termasuk pricing–DPD, L2 .03 dan shrink .25; terpisah |

V26–V34/V40 memakai L2 .003, shrink .5. V35–V37/V39 memakai L2 .01, shrink .5. Ini konfigurasi yang ditetapkan sebelum melihat hasil batch, bukan dipilih berdasarkan public leaderboard.

## Basket dan unit price

Audit ulang unique item IDs, konsistensi repeated order fields dan total item per order sebelum mengubah grain. Completed orders dipakai untuk spending; cancelled orders tetap ada dalam cache untuk provenance tetapi bukan spending. Opaque IDs tetap join keys. Tidak tersedia SKU/product ID, jadi yang diukur adalah kelangkaan **kombinasi kategori**, bukan kombinasi barang tertentu.

Rarity memakai Dirichlet .5 pada127 kategori-presence masks nonempty. Referensi memakai order dari6.000 correction-training customers, dengan timestamp sebelum awal bulan query. Own customer dikeluarkan untuk fitur correction-training; validation/test tidak masuk reference fitting. Minimal1.000 reference orders dan3 query orders. Pair lift memisahkan frekuensi kombinasi dari frekuensi marginal kategori. Jumlah observasi tetap dikontrol oleh coverage baseline.

Unit price adalah item_total/quantity. Reference pribadi menggunakan item kategori sama pada30–180 hari sebelum keputusan; query adalah0–30 hari. Minimal5 prior items, positive prior SD, positive quantity dan item value. Ukur mean/P90 z-score dan extreme share |z|>2.5. Ini tidak mengendalikan kualitas SKU yang memang tidak tersedia.

## Event alignment

Untuk approval/rejection, pilih keputusan historis terakhir yang memiliki30 hari follow-up sebelum cutoff dan60 hari bukti transaksi sebelum event. Hitung perubahan spending yang dinormalisasi income, perubahan dikurangi pretrend, credit-card share, dan Jensen–Shannon divergence seluruh lima metode bayar. Tidak ada klaim kausal; observasi provider tidak membuktikan enrollment kontinu.

Untuk due event lama, butuh due<=cutoff−7d dan bukti transaksi sejak due−14d. Gunakan +/-7 hari, assign setiap order ke satu due terdekat, deduplicate due timestamps customer yang sama. Bila jendela due bertumpang tindih, exposure dibagi pada midpoint. Duedates di180 hari terakhir boleh memakai order sampai187 hari untuk menjamin pre-window lengkap. Ini tidak memakai DPD sebagai waktu terjadinya tunggakan.

## Underwriting

Terdapat lima tier APR: .16,.20,.24,.28,.32. Model multiclass kecil memprediksi tier dari income, principal, bureau, pekerjaan, purpose dan histori kontraktual. Proposed installment dan APR tidak menjadi prediktor, karena installment merupakan fungsi APR. Label nuisance adalah APR, **bukan default**. Correction rows memakai3 inner-fold crossfit; outer validation/test hanya menerima prediksi. Probabilitas dicampur1% training prior dengan Jeffreys .5 class smoothing untuk menghindari zero probability pada tier langka. Simpan seluruh model inner/final.

Versi DPD mempunyai flag provenance terpisah dan tidak dipromosikan otomatis. Semua pipeline tetap mewarisi ketidakpastian snapshot DPD/amount_paid dan global references dari baseline; fitur baru tidak mensertifikasi keseluruhan pipeline.

## Maturity dan inquiry

Estimasi akhir kontrak=historical decision date+term_months, dengan penyesuaian akhir bulan kalender. Ini proxy origination/maturity, bukan bukti actual settlement. Jangan menyamakan loan masih dalam tenor dengan outstanding yang belum dilunasi.

Bureau harus available<=selected cutoff. Latest/previous report dibandingkan dalam provider yang sama; provider counts tidak dijumlahkan. Data hanya punya inquiries_last_6m, sehingga selisihnya adalah **perubahan net rolling count**, bukan jumlah inquiry baru atau timestamp inquiry individual. Interaksi memakai proximity exp(-abs(maturity_gap)/30) dan requested amount/income. Aplikasi historis near-maturity hanya dipasangkan dengan kontrak yang sudah diketahui sebelum aplikasi historis tersebut.

## Eksekusi dan hasil

`scripts/run_discovery_queue.py` menjalankan validasi, ekstraksi sekali, persiapan lima fold dengan dua worker CPU, lalu16 eksperimen. Kumo tetap100% frozen; tidak ada training GPU baru. Semua old outputs tetap ada. Setiap kandidat mempunyai submission30.000 aplikasi, OOF70.000 aplikasi, lima checkpoint koreksi, model nuisance, KS/AUC, paired CI dan risiko overfit. `reports/FEATURE_EXPERIMENTS.csv` serta registry best observed diperbarui; baseline aktif tidak otomatis diganti.

CI300 paired fold/class bootstrap bersifat conditional pada fitted OOF. Tidak mencakup retraining, multiple-search selection atau public uncertainty. Tidak ada untouched holdout dan tidak ada klaim perbaikan hidden-test sampai diamati. Kandidat AUC dan KS harus dinilai bersama, mengingat batch sebelumnya memberi kenaikan KS kecil dengan penurunan AUC.
active_method_documents.v7/STATISTICAL_PLAN.md:
# V60â€“V75: statistical mechanisms on the locked Kumo baseline

Baseline remains frozen Kumo Large90 + offset correction12 + original spline77.
Public KS0.56470 belongs only to the exact locked baseline CSV. No candidate
inherits that public score. This batch expands the correction feature branch;
the Kumo context, backbone, cached scores, original spline and CV indices stay fixed.

| ID | Method | New hypothesis |
|---|---|---|
| V60 | Depth2 Chen signature | Order of cashflow/spending changes matters beyond endpoints |
| V61 | Lead-lag lift, variation, turning | Path irregularity and ordered cross-channel changes |
| V62 | Payment-channel reconciliation | Direct vs deferred channel spending and observed account outflows |
| V63 | Contractual annuity residual | Contract pricing/schedules differ from simple amortization mathematics |
| V64 | QUARANTINED payment residual | Observed cumulative payment vs due and contractual PMT |
| V65 | Empirical joint-tail excess | Financial stress extremes co-occur beyond marginal frequencies |
| V66 | QUARANTINED DPD joint tails | Due-cohort delinquency severity with cash/spending extremes |
| V67 | Category Markov surprisal | Rare category transitions, including recent change in rarity |
| V68 | Payment-method Markov surprisal | Rare payment-method transitions |
| V69 | Compositional balances | Relative category/payment allocation and recent shifts |
| V70 | Fold/month-local latent bureau | Provider scale/noise and latest-report uncertainty |
| V71 | Freshness-inflated latent bureau | Prespecified information-age penalty |
| V72 | V60+V61+V62 | Joint path and reconciliation signal |
| V73 | V67+V68+V69 | Sequence rarity vs relative composition |
| V74 | All incremental low-risk families | Conservative combined correction |
| V75 | All plus snapshot-dependent families | Research-only comparison |

V60â€“V71 use L2=0.003 and inference strength0.5. V72â€“V73 use L2=0.01,
strength0.5. V74â€“V75 use L2=0.03, strength0.25. No tuning against outer folds.
All comparisons use the original5fold seed31027 with50k context/6k correction/
14k validation per fold. Default target is not used for feature references.

## Mathematical definitions

Path signature, piecewise-linear segments `dx`:

`S2 <- S2 + outer(S1,dx) + .5*outer(dx,dx); S1 <- S1+dx`.

Signed cross-area is `(S2_ij-S2_ji)/2`. Channels are normalized time0:1,
netCF/median observed income-like credits and spending/the same income scale.
The latest uninterrupted run of6â€“12 complete overlapping months is required.
Missing months break the path; they are not interpolated. Lead-lag lift repeats
observations and offsets the two copies by one step. Path variation sums
Euclidean increment lengths; turning averages `1-cos(adjacent increments)`.

Channel reconciliation: direct=`debit_card+bank_transfer`; credit channel=
`credit_card`. Monthly direct/outflows, direct/completed-spend and credit/
completed-spend are aggregated over matching complete months. Recent3m minus
prior months within12m measures share shift. Within-person correlation needs
at least6 contiguous months. COD/e-wallet are kept separate. No assumption
that all payments use the observed bank account is made.

Annuity proxy: `PMT=P*r/(1-(1+r)^(-n))`, `r=APR/12`; when r=0, `PMT=P/n`.
Safe residuals compare scheduled installment or historical amount_due to PMT.
Payment residuals use `sum(max(amount_due-amount_paid,0))/sum(amount_due)` or
`(sum(amount_paid)-sum(PMT))/sum(PMT)` over the same observed installments and
are quarantined. These are not actual outstanding principal. No first-due
schedule is fabricated. Fees/rounding/flat-rate conventions may explain gaps.

Tail dependence: A=`netCF<=personalP20`, B=`spend>=personalP80`. Four-cell
Dirichlet(0.5) smoothing gives `pA=(nA+1)/(n+2)`, `pB=(nB+1)/(n+2)`,
`pAB=(nAB+.5)/(n+2)`. Excess=`pAB-pA*pB`, lift=`pAB/(pA*pB)`; persistence
is longest consecutive joint event run/n. This is an empirical small-history
tail diagnostic, not a fitted copula. DPD extension concerns eventual-by-cutoff
severity of sufficiently aged due cohorts; it does not reconstruct month-end
DPD or threshold-crossing timestamps.

Markov: `P(b|a)=(N_ab+.5)/(sum_b N_ab+.5*K)`; event surprisal=
`-log(P(b|a))`, K=7 dominant item-value categories or K=5 payment methods.
Mean/P90 need at least5 transitions in90d; recent-vs-prior change requires5
in each window. Equal timestamps and dominant-category ties are excluded from
category transitions. Population counts use correction customers only, ending
events strictly before query decision-month start. Three inner folds exclude
the training query customer from its reference. No validation/test reference
data or default labels are used. Counts and reference checkpoints are saved.

Compositional balance:
`sqrt(r*s/(r+s)) * (mean(log(share_A+delta))-mean(log(share_B+delta)))`.
`delta=1e-3/K` is fixed relative mass, with renormalization. All-zero spend
stays missing. Category groups: health+education vs fashion+electronics,
groceries vs other categories, home vs personal_care. Payment groups:
credit_card vs bank_transfer+debit_card, e_wallet vs the same direct group.
Compute30d level and0:30d minus30:90d change. Group semantics are hypotheses,
not a verified essential/discretionary taxonomy.

Latent bureau: `score_j=theta+b_j+eps_j`, independent provider noise. Paired
training score differences estimate centered offsets and noise variances,
with a variance floor. Gaussian prior and noise are estimated only from the
correction reference customers whose report was available before query month.
Posterior variance=`1/(1/tau2+sum_j1/v_j)` and mean=
`var*(mu/tau2+sum_j(score_j-b_j)/v_j)`. One latest eligible report/provider
avoids counting repeated reports as independent evidence. V71 multiplies
`v_j` by `1+report_age_days/180`, a prespecified hypothesis. Sparse references
use an explicit fixed prior, not future data. Three inner folds avoid fitting
the training query's own reference. Existing baseline latent features remain;
this is an enhancement rather than a wholly new baseline mechanism.

## Feature and evaluation records

Raw/fold-local definitions are written to
`v7/statistical/reports/FEATURE_CATALOG.csv`. Every completed experiment gets
`v7/runs/Vxx/METHOD.json`, `REPORT.md`, `RESULT.json`, `OOF.csv`, five correction
checkpoints and a separately hashed30k-row submission CSV.

`v7/reports/EXPERIMENT_METHOD_INDEX.csv` indexes all completed experiments,
including older batches. `EXPERIMENT_FEATURE_FORMULAS.csv` records their added
feature formulas, sources, windows and caveats. KS and AUC, paired delta CIs,
per-fold changes, correction complexity and overfitting flags are retained,
including negative results. CI bootstrap300 is conditional on fitted OOF,
not corrected for repeated model search or training-seed variation.

Kumo stays100% frozen. The active baseline is not automatically promoted.
Inherited source snapshot/global-reference uncertainty is not removed by
making new features safer. No private-test improvement or KS0.57 is promised.

## Queue

Raw extraction overlaps the repaired V42â€“V59 repayment queue. Model jobs wait
for that queue, then run two CPU workers using cached frozen Kumo scores.
Status: `v7/reports/STATISTICAL_QUEUE.json`. Logs: `v7/logs/`.

# Conditional financial mechanisms: batch lanjutan

Tambahan12 eksperimen V14â€“V25 sesudah14 eksperimen V7 awal. Seluruhnya memakai baseline offset terkunci, lima fold yang sama, Kumo100% frozen dan spline lama. Tidak mengubah skor atau file baseline.

| ID | Mekanisme |
|---|---|
| V14 | Conditional late-allocation propensity, Empirical Bayes + uncertainty + exposure |
| V15 | Conditional DPD15 propensity; provenance snapshot belum terverifikasi |
| V16 | Nonlinear debt payment cliff |
| V17 | Pemulihan cashflow dan saldo setelah bulan defisit |
| V18 | Belanja naik bersamaan dengan observed income turun |
| V19 | Residual bunga dari model underwriting target-free yang cross-fitted |
| V20 | DPD severity Ã— tekanan konsumsi; provenance belum terverifikasi |
| V21 | Residual bureau terhadap repayment DPD; provenance belum terverifikasi |
| V22 | Urutan approval â†’ observed delayed allocation â†’ rejection |
| V23 | Gabungan incremental features tanpa DPD baru |
| V24 | Gabungan termasuk DPD baru, regularisasi dan shrinkage lebih kuat; dipisahkan |
| V25 | Kontrol exposure-only untuk menilai kontribusi posterior V14 |

Fitur DPD berbobot nominal, streak DPD, e-commerce/outflow dan spending setelah rejection sudah masuk V7 awal; tidak diulang sebagai fitur identik.

Conditional rate memakai satu unit borrower-month, dengan event setidaknya satu eligible installment. Due-age minimal15 hari, cashflow dari bulan due yang lengkap. Pisahkan exposure CF negatif dan nonnegatif. Alpha/beta Beta-Binomial diestimasi hanya dari correction-training, tanpa default labels. Delta posterior dan uncertainty ditandai missing bila salah satu kondisi belum pernah teramati. Priors tidak membuat observasi yang tidak ada menjadi bukti individual. Korelasi serial antarbulan dapat membuat variance posterior terlalu optimistis.

DPD maksimal adalah snapshot sampai selected cutoff. Ia tidak membuktikan bahwa DPD terjadi pada due month atau sebelum historical rejection. V15/V20/V21/V24 tetap diberi tanda provenance; fitur credit-access memakai urutan timestamp last-allocation yang benar-benar teramati dan secara eksplisit bukan trajektori DPD. DPD worsening sebelum rejection tidak direkonstruksi dengan membocorkan snapshot terbaru ke keputusan lama.

Debt cliff punya dua definisi terpisah. `net_new` menambahkan hanya kewajiban baru terhadap net cashflow historis, karena outflows bisa sudah mencakup cicilan lama. `gross_scheduled` membandingkan cicilan baru+kontrak lama yang masih dalam tenor terhadap income bruto teramati. Kontrak masih dalam tenor bukan bukti belum dilunasi lebih awal. Denominator nol/negatif tidak disamarkan dengan epsilon; ada indikator nonpositive capacity dan shortfall terpisah.

Recovery hanya memakai bulan kalender berurutan. Episode tanpa1/3 bulan follow-up tetap censored/missing. Simpan jumlah episode matang, peluang pemulihan satu bulan, waktu terbatasi3 bulan, kegagalan flow dan kegagalan saldo. Episode bisa tumpang tindih; jangan menganggap semuanya independen.

Decoupling memerlukan enam bulan rekening berurutan dan bukti histori e-commerce sejak awal window. Spending memakai completed item_total, tidak menghitung ulang order_total per item. Rasio dengan nol tetap undefined. Enrollment provider tidak diketahui; coverage tetap bagian caveat.

Pricing residual memakai rate, bukan label default. Model residual bunga dan bureau dilatih dengan3 inner-fold crossfit pada6.000 correction rows. Outer validation/test hanya menerima prediksi. Pricing merupakan hasil kebijakan kredit, sehingga residual bukan bukti kausal hidden risk.

Prediktor residual bunga tidak memakai proposed installment, karena cicilan itu sendiri merupakan fungsi bunga, principal dan tenor. Ini menghindari residual yang hanya merekonstruksi rumus pricing. Data aktual mempunyai lima tingkat bunga: .16, .20, .24, .28 dan .32; model tetap harus dinilai sebagai hipotesis credit policy, bukan sinyal perilaku independen.

Setiap eksperimen menyimpan OOF, KS/AUC, delta KS, paired conditional bootstrap CI, diagnostik overfit, lima checkpoint dan submission CSV. V14 dibandingkan lagi dengan V25 untuk membedakan nilai posterior dari coverage. Dua worker CPU berjalan setelah batch awal selesai; ekstraksi tambahan boleh berjalan paralel sekarang. Hasil bersifat development evidence; tidak ada untouched holdout atau klaim public score untuk CSV baru.

# Batch V102â€“V117: multi-view, sequence, peer, and financial responses

Status: implemented and queued after lifecycle V90â€“V101. Raw extraction may run concurrently with preceding batches. Results are pending; no KS/AUC gain is asserted. Original source notebooks and locked baseline remain unchanged.

## Matched experiment matrix

| ID | Added information | Primary comparison |
|---|---|---|
| V102 | Three source-only default probabilities | Locked baseline and V90 support control |
| V103 | V102 plus disagreement, variance, consensus, categorical maximum-risk source | V102 |
| V104 | Fixed burst/collapse/high-low-high spending templates | Baseline and V90 |
| V105 | Learned good/bad spending and order-frequency shapelets | V104 |
| V106 | Training-only KNN, novelty LOF, credit-neighbor behavior distance | Baseline and V90 |
| V107 | Category substitution aligned with observed income declines | Baseline and V90 |
| V108 | Selection/observation-propensity weighted mature DPD15/30 | Baseline and V90 |
| V109 | Dated population calendar residuals | Baseline and V90 |
| V110 | Censor-aware population Weibull plus individual Gamma renewal | V116 old proxy |
| V111 | Default-target-free masked monthly reconstruction SSL16 | V117 PCA16 and V90 |
| V112 | Multi-view plus peer anomalies | Baseline and V90 |
| V113 | Shapelets plus dormancy | Baseline and V90 |
| V114 | All mechanisms except SSL | Baseline and V90 |
| V115 | All eight mechanisms including SSL | Baseline and V90 |
| V116 | Archived recency Ã— historical intensity proxy | Baseline and V90 |
| V117 | Monthly PCA16 control | Baseline and V90 |

All singles use the original correction penalty 0.003 and inference strength 0.5. V112/V113 use penalty 0.01, strength 0.5. V114/V115 use penalty 0.03, strength 0.25. These are prespecified configurations, not tuned against outer validation. Every nonempty experiment includes the same four existing coverage columns, with V90 as their explicit control. No additional context rows or backbone inputs are added.

## Methods and formulas

1. **Multi-view:** source-restricted small LightGBM models use seven ecommerce, seven credit, or five account features. Each has 120 trees, depth3, 7 leaves, minimum80 observations per leaf, learning rate0.04, L2=20. If LightGBM is unavailable the recorded backend is sklearn histogram boosting (80 iterations, 7 leaves, minimum80, L2=20). Train each on two thirds of the 6,000 correction customers and generate the held-out third's probabilities; outer validation and test use the model trained on all correction customers. Features are each probability, ecommerceâˆ’credit, variance, minimum probability, max(ecommerce,account)âˆ’credit, and categorical argmax. These are diagnostic auxiliary models, not a standalone replacement for Kumo.
2. **Shapelets:** construct 26 weeks of completed unique-order spending and counts ending before the incomplete decision day. Require the first recorded ecommerce event to precede the window, retaining the caveat that this does not certify platform enrollment. For motif m and each same-length weekly window w, use `min_w sqrt(mean((z(w)-z(m))Â²))`. Fixed four-week motifs are [0,0,1,0], [1,1,0,0], and [1,0,0,1]. Learned motifs search lengths3/4/6 and16 candidates per class per length, with at most800 training customers for selection. Select greatest mean distance separation, within each inner training fold only. Store bad/good distances and goodâˆ’bad distance. Unsupported histories stay missing.
3. **Peer novelty:** signed log, median imputation, missing indicators, and standardization fitted on reference customers. Use 20 neighbors on income/installment/bureau/utilization/DPD/spending/balance/account-income coordinates, density `1/(mean_distance+1e-6)`, distance P10, negative novelty-LOF score, and behavior distance from median behavior of neighbors selected by the first four financial coordinates. Query customers are excluded from references. IDs are join keys only.
4. **Consumption substitution:** match complete account months with item-category values from completed orders. Income shock is a decrease of at least10% over consecutive observed months with positive prior income. Use mean Î”log1p(groceries)âˆ’Î”log1p(fashion+electronics), discretionary spending stickiness, spending reduction/income reduction, and category-share Jensenâ€“Shannon change in stress versus nonstress months (at least2 each; both month totals positive). Adjustment delay uses only shock anchors with three fully observed subsequent months; no response coded4. Category names form an exploratory mapping, not verified household necessity. Zero orders are inferred only after the first recorded ecommerce month; enrollment remains unknown.
5. **Selection adjustment:** historical approval model inputs are log requested amount, tenor, and application calendar only; the repayment-observation model additionally uses historical contract age at the reference cutoff. Fit on earlier-cutoff reference customers, without selected-loan target labels. Define `w=clip(pooled_approval*pooled_observation/(clip(p_approval,.05,.95)*clip(p_observed,.05,.95)),.2,5)`. Aggregate loan-equal mature DPD rates using these weights. Denominators require due-ageâ‰¥15/30 respectively. Include weight strength, observation propensity, effective loans `(sum w)^2/sum(wÂ²)`, and historical approval residual. This is a clipped sensitivity experiment under missing-at-random/overlap assumptions, not an identified counterfactual risk estimate for rejected loans. No claim that weighting automatically removes selection bias.
6. **Calendar residual:** on reference-customer complete months strictly preceding the query decision month, fit small regularized regressions for log1p(monthly spending/orders/outflows) using calendar period, month sin/cos, and log observed income. Residual is observed minus expected. Use recent3-month means and recent3 versus prior3 spending residual change. Missing ecommerce visibility stays missing. No assumed Ramadan/promotion effects.
7. **Dormancy:** estimate pooled Weibull shape k/scale from earlier-cutoff reference customers' complete gaps and right-censored last gaps. Conditional individual rate prior `lambda~Gamma(5,5*scale^k)` gives `a=5+n`, `b=5*scale^k+sum(gap^k)`. Completed own gaps alone update the query posterior, avoiding double conditioning on the current inactivity whose surprise is measured. Predictive survivor `S(t)=(b/(b+t^k))^a`, surprise `a*log1p(t^k/b)`, hazard `a*k*t^(k-1)/(b+t^k)`, expected gap `Gamma(1+1/k)*b^(1/k)*Gamma(a-1/k)/Gamma(a)`, and rate CV `1/sqrt(a)`. Require at least2 own gaps. V116 reproduces `recency*(completed_orders_aged90to365+1)/275`. Dormancy denotes observed inactivity, not verified account closure.
8. **SSL16:** sequence is 12 complete months Ã— income-like credits, outflows, net cashflow, closing balance, unique-order spending, and order counts. Signed-log means/scales and PCA fitted on correction customers only. Denoising encoder `[values,observed_mask,corruption_mask] ->64 GELU->16`, decoder16->64 GELU->72; reconstruct20% masked observed cells by MSE, 6 fixed epochs, batch512, AdamW lr0.001/weight_decay0.01, grad norm2. No default label is used. One fitted encoder per outer fold supplies a shared coordinate system for correction/validation/test; independently rotated inner encoders are avoided. PCA16 uses the identical normalized values/missingness information. Encoder weights, preprocessing, losses, and PCA checkpoint are saved per fold. All-history-missing rows receive missing embeddings.

## Evaluation, provenance, and outputs

Use the locked five outer folds and identical context/correction/validation partitions. Kumo100% frozen and original spline77 fixed. New features enter only the regularized correction branch. Every run saves OOF, five correction checkpoints, its own 30,000-row submission, SHA256, KS, signed KS, AUC, per-fold deltas, 300-resample fold/class-stratified paired confidence intervals, and head train/validation diagnostics. Separate paired comparisons use V90 and the specified controls above. Bootstrap is conditional on fitted predictions and does not correct repeated search or retraining variability.

DPD remains enabled without quarantine as instructed. Historical snapshot provenance remains unverified; neither eligible due-age nor filtering due dates proves that retrospective maximum DPD was available at cutoff. Selected-loan default labels appear only in inner cross-fitted multi-view/shapelet auxiliaries and final correction training. No outer-validation or test target enters feature fitting. These reused retrospective folds do not establish that every 12-month training target was mature before each historical prediction date. No independent temporal-generalization or public-score claim is made.

Implementation: `v7/scripts/fusion_features.py`, `v7/scripts/run_fusion_queue.py`, `v7/fusion_plan.json`. Feature formulas: `v7/fusion/reports/FEATURE_CATALOG.csv`. Queue: `v7/reports/FUSION_QUEUE.json`. Results/submissions: `v7/runs/Vxxx/` and `v7/submissions/`. Master MD/CSV/JSON refreshes every30 seconds, including negative results, failures, method formulas, and pending entries without invented metrics.

# Mengapa baseline offset lebih baik di leaderboard?

Perbandingan harus memakai metrik yang sama. Public KS 0.56470 tidak langsung dibandingkan dengan OOF KS 0.53. Angka public berasal dari laporan pengguna, diikat ke checksum CSV.

| Model | Pooled OOF KS | Mean fold KS | OOF AUC | Public KS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|Offset baseline|0.52929947|0.53290659|0.84720269|0.56470|
|Select64|0.53079541|0.53173235|0.84707685|0.56082|
|Resep asli|0.52850998|0.53095459|0.84732114|0.56393|

## Temuan yang langsung didukung data

Baseline offset menang 4/5 fold terhadap select64. Mean fold KS lebih tinggi +0.00117424, walaupun pooled OOF KS lebih rendah -0.00149595. AUC berubah+0.00012583.
Pooled KS mengambil maksimum pemisahan distribusi pada gabungan prediksi beberapa model fold. Mean fold KS merangkum pemisahan dalam setiap model. Urutan kandidat bisa berbeda; ini tidak membuktikan salah satu metrik selalu lebih tepat.
Paired bootstrap delta pooled KS offset-minus-select64:[-0.00447372,+0.00174506],300 resamples menurut fold/kelas. CI ini tidak mengukur ketidakpastian public dan tidak mengoreksi pemilihan model.
Kontrol kekuatan koreksi dari sumber: setengah koreksi KS 0.52929947, koreksi penuh KS 0.52757031; delta+0.00172915. Setengah koreksi menang 5/5 fold terhadap resep asli; koreksi penuh hanya2/5.
Kedua varian memakai koefisien yang difit dengan objective yang sama; faktor 0.5 diterapkan sesudah fitting. Data mendukung hipotesis bahwa koreksi penuh terlalu kuat untuk representasi ini. Ini bukan bukti bahwa shrinkage0.5 selalu optimal.
Pada penalti 0.003 dan kekuatan 0.5 yang sama, unweighted KS 0.52929947, class-balanced KS 0.52859429. Preferensi loss di sini didukung hasil OOF, sehingga tidak perlu menganggap class weighting otomatis membantu data yang tidak seimbang.
Kontrol numerik: koreksi sendiri menambah pooled KS+0.00081202 terhadap Kumo yang direkonstruksi tanpa koreksi, dan menang 5/5 fold. Perbedaan numerik backbone bukan penjelasan utama peningkatannya.
Hasil negatif juga perlu dicatat: simpangan KS antar-fold offset 0.00547484 lebih besar daripada select64 0.00503293. Menang lebih banyak fold tidak berarti semua ukuran kestabilan membaik. Terhadap resep asli, logloss OOF sedikit memburuk dari 0.29242935 menjadi 0.29249967, dan AUC sedikit turun.

## Mekanisme yang masuk akal, belum terisolasi sepenuhnya

Input Kumo90 dipertahankan. Model koreksi memiliki 60 koefisien berpenalti yang dilatih pada 6.000 baris berlabel di luar context 50.000, kemudian diterapkan pada query dengan context Kumo yang sama. Tidak ada fine-tuning backbone.
Koreksi menggunakan posterior dan uncertainty harga/bureau, income, repayment serta burden dan pekerjaan. Ini memungkinkan penyesuaian risiko bersyarat sambil mempertahankan skor dasar sebagai offset.
Select64 mengubah informasi masuk Kumo dan memakai spline87 dengan tambahan basket/domain. Pemilihannya menggunakan proxy HistGradientBoosting dan pooled CV yang digunakan berulang. Karena beberapa bagian berubah sekaligus, kita belum bisa menyalahkan satu fitur atau menyatakan pruning pasti penyebab penurunan public.
Prediksi test adalah rata-rata lima model, sedangkan setiap baris OOF menerima prediksi satu model fold. Stabilitas antar-model dan skala skor dapat memengaruhi peringkat hasil. Perbedaan ini masuk akal sebagai hipotesis, tetapi belum diisolasi oleh hasil ini.
## Keputusan untuk baseline berikutnya

Pertahankan resep90 fitur,12 fitur koreksi,60 koefisien, L2=0.003, unweighted, strength0.5 dan blend75:25 sebagai titik awal tetap. Jangan memilih model hanya karena pooled OOF tertinggi.
Bandingkan pooled KS, mean/per-fold KS, AUC, held-out loss, paired uncertainty dan stabilitas beberapa seed. Gunakan perubahan tunggal serta pembagian yang sama saat eksperimen baru memang diminta.
Public naik 0.00388 versus select64, tetapi tidak tersedia label atau keanggotaan subset public untuk menguji signifikansinya. CI perbaikan baseline offset terhadap resep asli juga masih mencakup nol. Tidak ada klaim bebas overfit atau sebab-akibat.
Semua hasil di sini berasal dari checkpoint/prediksi yang sudah ada. Tidak ada model dilatih, antrean diaktifkan, atau submission eksperimen baru dibuat.

# Baseline aktif: Frozen Kumo Large + koreksi offset + spline

Baseline ini berasal dari `submission_goal054_kumo_offset_l20p003_unweighted_d0p5_w1.csv` di proyek sumber `/home/taqiyudinmiftah/Logika`. Public KS **0.56470** dilaporkan pengguna untuk file tersebut. SHA-256 yang dikunci:

`5d4d8b81e781354a3d1302aadfe93a1534e42e35279ba4867a7b4d0e1990dd33`

Workspace aktif: `/home/taqiyudinmiftah/adit/Logika/insight/goal054_offset_baseline_20261019`.
Eksperimen sebelumnya dinonaktifkan dan disimpan sebagai arsip; baseline baru tidak mengimpor kode atau model dari folder eksperimen lama.

## Cara kerja

1. **Kumo Large dengan 90 fitur**, termasuk aplikasi, histori kredit, rekening dan e-commerce. Seluruh bobot backbone dibekukan. Kumo menggunakan 50.000 contoh berlabel sebagai context, delapan estimator dan seed `2026 + fold`.
2. **Model koreksi kecil berbentuk offset logistic regression.** Prediksi Kumo menjadi nilai awal tetap di ruang logit. Koreksi dipelajari dari 12 fitur risiko, termasuk posterior/uncertainty harga dan bureau, income, repayment, beban cicilan serta pekerjaan. Model ini belajar kesalahan yang masih tersisa setelah Kumo.
3. **Spline logistic lama dengan 77 fitur** tetap dipertahankan sebagai cabang kedua. Probabilitas akhir mencampurkan 75% corrected Kumo dan 25% spline.
4. **Rata-rata probabilitas lima fold** menghasilkan submission 30.000 aplikasi.

Untuk setiap aplikasi:

`z = logit(clip(p_Kumo, 1e-6, 1-1e-6))`

`delta = beta0 + beta1 * standardized(z) + spline_basis(x) @ beta_features`

`p_corrected = sigmoid(z + 0.5 * delta)`

`p_final = 0.75 * p_corrected + 0.25 * p_spline`

Koreksi tergantung fitur nasabah, sehingga dapat mengubah urutan risiko. Ini bukan sekadar transformasi monoton terhadap satu skor. Kalibrasi monoton saja tidak otomatis meningkatkan KS.

## Pelatihan koreksi dan pembagian data

Lima outer fold memakai `StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=31027)` yang sama dengan sumber. Setiap fold:

| Bagian | Baris | Kegunaan |
|---|---:|---|
| Context | 50.000 | Kumo melihat fitur dan labelnya |
| Correction training | 6.000 | Label tidak masuk context Kumo; melatih model koreksi |
| Outer validation | 14.000 | Mengevaluasi gabungan model |

Ketiganya diperiksa terpisah. Spline lama dilatih pada keseluruhan 56.000 outer-training, tetap terpisah dari 14.000 outer-validation. Tidak ada label test.

Preprocessing koreksi dipasang hanya pada 6.000 baris correction-training: signed log, imputasi median, quadratic quantile spline dengan tiga knot, standardisasi, missing indicators dan one-hot pekerjaan. Intercept dan standardized Kumo logit juga masuk matriks desain.

Loss adalah mean binary cross-entropy biasa ditambah `0.003 / 2 * sum(beta[1:]**2)`. Intercept tidak dipenalti. Tidak ada class balancing. Optimizer L-BFGS-B menggunakan maksimum 300 iterasi. **Model difit dengan koreksi penuh; faktor 0.5 baru diterapkan saat prediksi**, mengikuti sumber persis.

Arti nama file:

| Bagian | Arti |
|---|---|
| `l20p003` | Penalti L2 sebesar 0.003 |
| `unweighted` | Bobot loss kedua kelas sama |
| `d0p5` | Pengaruh koreksi logit diperkecil menjadi setengah; bukan clipping +/-0.5 |
| `w1` | Menggunakan kandidat ini sepenuhnya; kandidat tersebut sudah mencakup campuran Kumo/spline 75:25 |

## Hasil yang diwarisi dan diverifikasi

| Resep | Pooled OOF KS | Mean fold KS | OOF AUC | Public KS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Resep lama tanpa koreksi | 0.52850998 | 0.53095459 | 0.84732114 | 0.56393 |
| Baseline offset ini | 0.52929947 | 0.53290659 | 0.84720269 | 0.56470 |

Koreksi naik pada **5/5 fold** terhadap resep lama. Delta pooled KS `+0.00078949`; delta rata-rata KS fold `+0.00195200`. AUC sedikit turun, sehingga peningkatan pemisahan tidak seragam pada seluruh distribusi skor.

Pemeriksaan tambahan juga menemukan logloss OOF sedikit memburuk dibanding resep asli: `0.29242935` menjadi `0.29249967`. Baseline ini memperbaiki KS yang diamati, bukan seluruh ukuran kualitas probabilitas sekaligus. Analisis terhadap select64 tersedia dalam `WHY_BASELINE_WORKS.md`.

Paired bootstrap sumber, 300 resamples yang distratifikasi menurut fold dan kelas, memberi CI 95% delta KS **[-0.00128622, +0.00272947]**. Interval masih mencakup nol dan tidak memperhitungkan pemilihan kandidat maupun variasi pelatihan. Public naik `+0.00077` menurut laporan pengguna; ketidakpastian perbandingan public tidak dapat dihitung tanpa label dan keanggotaan subset evaluasinya.

Kumo yang dihitung ulang sedikit berbeda secara numerik dari checkpoint prediksi lama. Kontrol sumber memisahkan pengaruh tersebut: perubahan numerik memberi delta pooled KS `-0.00002253`, sedangkan koreksi sendiri memberi `+0.00081202` dan naik pada 5/5 fold. Baseline yang dikunci memakai prediksi Kumo aktual yang menjadi sumber CSV ini.

## Menjalankan

Gunakan lingkungan yang sudah tersedia, dengan versi di `requirements-lock.txt`:

```bash
cd /home/taqiyudinmiftah/adit/Logika/insight/goal054_offset_baseline_20261019
/tmp/logika-kumo-env/bin/python scripts/baseline.py
```

Perintah default menghitung ulang prediksi dari checkpoint koreksi dan spline, memakai cached scores dari backbone Kumo yang frozen. Semua sumber, ID, split, objective dan hash diperiksa. File hasil harus sama persis dengan submission yang dikunci. Tidak ada pelatihan GPU baru.

```bash
/tmp/logika-kumo-env/bin/python scripts/baseline.py --refit-correction
```

Opsi ini melatih ulang koreksi menggunakan pembagian 6.000 baris yang sama. Output masuk `reproduced/`, tanpa menimpa checkpoint atau submission baseline. Skor public tidak otomatis diwariskan jika byte output berbeda.

Untuk menghitung context Kumo dari awal di GPU, tersedia perintah terpisah yang tidak dijalankan otomatis:

```bash
/tmp/logika-kumo-env/bin/python scripts/fresh_context.py --fold 0
# Tanpa --fold: menjalankan kelima fold dengan resep yang tetap.
```

Perintah tersebut memuat backbone dari checkpoint lokal, membekukan semua bobot, menghitung prediksi context/holdout/query, lalu melatih koreksi pada 6.000 baris yang sama. Hasil masuk `fresh/`. Perbedaan numerik FP16 dapat menghasilkan CSV berbeda; skor public baseline tidak otomatis berlaku untuk hasil baru. Jalur GPU fresh belum dijalankan dalam pemindahan ini. Loader checkpoint lokal diuji di CPU tanpa pelatihan.

Checkpoint Kumo tersimpan di `checkpoints/kumo_large/classifier.pt`; checkpoint koreksi dan spline serta prediksi tiap fold tersimpan di `artifacts/foldN/`. `data/FEATURES.csv` menjelaskan fitur yang masuk setiap cabang. `provenance/` menyimpan definisi, laporan, metadata dan kode asli sebagai referensi yang tidak diubah.

## Batasan yang tetap berlaku

Pemilihan delapan konfigurasi koreksi dan penelitian sebelumnya telah menggunakan label/fold yang sama. Hasil ini bukan validasi independen yang belum pernah disentuh. Kenaikan 5/5 fold dan public tidak membuktikan bebas overfit.

Nilai fitur dipertahankan persis dari sumber, termasuk asumsi global population reference dan snapshot DPD/amount-paid yang provenance point-in-time-nya belum terbukti. Memindahkan baseline dan memeriksa disjointness label tidak menyelesaikan ketidakpastian tersebut.

Tidak ada eksperimen baru yang dimasukkan antrean oleh pemindahan ini. `BASELINE_LOCK.json`, `reports/IMPORT_MANIFEST.json` dan `reports/REPLAY_AUDIT.json` menjadi sumber identitas baseline aktif.

CAUSILO_REPORT.md.text:
# Causilo evaluation on Indonesian credit risk

Causilo was actually run on the A10080GB. The locked439-feature candidate reached
audit KS **0.520437**, AUC **0.842323**. Against CatBoost500 on the
same14,000 audit applications, delta KS is **+0.018498**; paired
stratified bootstrap95% CI **[+0.006744, +0.030996]**
using1,000 resamples. Audit has1,901 defaults. KS0.60 has not been achieved.

![Class scoreCDFs and the observed maximum separation](figures/causilo_audit_cdf.png)

This establishes improvement over that CatBoost baseline. It does not establish
superiority to the best three-expert ensemble. That comparison requires matched
expert predictions and evidence that adding Causilo contributes beyond them.

## Matched development experiments

| View | Columns | Retained | KS | AUC | Seconds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| base | 169 | 164 | 0.511728 | 0.834647 | 29.2 |
| refactor | 219 | 210 | 0.513111 | 0.834723 | 35.7 |
| all | 439 | 403 | 0.519315 | 0.837147 | 63.0 |

Screening used42,000 context rows and14,000 query rows. Each model used the default
eight ensemble members, seed20261011, no training-context subsampling. Retained
columns differ because the official encoder removes training-context constants.
Fit/predict seconds exclude waiting for the shared GPU lock.

The439-column view adds270 columns to baseline169:50 refactor columns,64 earlier
targeted features,4 event-count columns,5 aligned-evidence columns and147 advanced
features. The all-versus-base gain measures this combined representation; it must
not be attributed exclusively to the147-column family.

| Model | Pooled_KS | AUC | Fold_mean | Fold_SD | Delta_vs_CB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| causilo_all_e8 | 0.510974 | 0.834867 | 0.513893 | 0.007694 | +0.017916 |
| causilo_refactor_e8 | 0.501867 | 0.831547 | 0.503882 | 0.007007 | +0.008809 |
| causilo_base_e8 | 0.500264 | 0.831614 | 0.504106 | 0.005871 | +0.007206 |

Four month-by-target-stratified development folds cover56,000 applications.
Every context contains42,000 applications; each validation contains14,000.
Customers are disjoint. View/hyperparameter selection uses development labels,
so these are selection diagnostics, not fully nested independent performance
estimates. Paired CIs are conditional and omit selection uncertainty.

| Candidate | Reference | Delta_KS | Paired_95CI | Positive_folds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| causilo_refactor_e8 | causilo_base_e8 | +0.001603 | [-0.002578, +0.004513] | 3/4 |
| causilo_all_e8 | causilo_base_e8 | +0.010710 | [+0.004911, +0.014586] | 4/4 |
| causilo_all_e8 | causilo_refactor_e8 | +0.009107 | [+0.004456, +0.013802] | 4/4 |

## Locked audit and interpretation

The Causilo view, eight-member ensemble, seed and checkpoint were written to
`config/causilo_candidate_lock.json` before audit scoring. They were not revised
after seeing audit results. The audit reference used identical training56k and
validation14k rows. Baseline KS0.501939, AUC0.831371.
Mean Causilo score is0.326502 for defaults versus
0.103322 for non-defaults; higher scores indicate risk.

This split was reserved from this round of model selection. Earlier project EDA
had inspected the overall training population; it is not a pristine external
test. Both competition train and test span2025, so a within-year customer-disjoint
split resembles the observed competition distribution. January-September toQ4
is a retrospective origination-cohort stress test. There is no extraction date,
default-event date or censoring date to certify12-month label maturity or a
genuine prospective12-month training embargo. Do not describe these numbers as
proven performance in future lending deployment.

## Reproducibility and temporal safety

Official source: https://github.com/nums-ai/causilo . Package1.0.3, source commit
`4d26d497de28734db52c6bfc2ea949c12cc17308`. Official checkpoint revision
`94f2bd91db0737d4da59f347910662905ecb5a09`. Exact file hashes, context/query
membership and dependency versions are recorded per fit in `models/*.json`.
PyTorch2.13.0+cu130 is isolated in `.venv_causilo`; existing expert environments
are unchanged. Pandas2.3.3, NumPy2.2.6 and sklearn1.7.2 match the earlier pipeline.
Public weights were downloaded with `hf`; borrower data was not uploaded.

All preprocessing and PatternRefactor transforms fit on the context only. No
query labels enter context, feature selection, normalization or stopping. Inputs
use the existing audited point-in-time caches. Previous decisions precede the
selected application; allocation timestamps precede cutoff; bank months are
complete; bureau uses availability timestamps; e-commerce spending deduplicates
completed orders. Unsafe retrospective DPD/amount-paid fields and opaque IDs
are excluded. Profile declarations remain unversioned, and scheduled debt is a
contractual proxy rather than actual remaining debt. Legacy essential/discretionary
proxy columns must be interpreted only as the exact literal category sums in
their original registry, not as authoritative consumer-need classifications.

Source code and model weights have separate licenses. The downloaded model
license is retained with the public checkpoint; this run is research evaluation.
Causilo is tested as a predictive classifier. No causal identification or causal
effect claim follows from its name or its predictions.

## Submission and next decision

Final fit status: complete, full70,000 labeled training context and30,000 test queries.
Submission status: created and validated: `submission_causilo.csv`.
It follows `sample_submission.csv` exactly, with application IDs and continuous
default-risk scores. No leaderboard upload was performed. The standalone
Causilo file is a candidate; selecting a primary blend must use development
evidence and a written lock, not repeated audit or leaderboard feedback.

Use `CAUSILO_README.md`, `requirements_causilo.txt`, and scripts21/23/25/27/29 to
reproduce. Numerical results are in `tables/causilo_*.csv` and
`tables/causilo_locked_audit.json`. Additional three-expert statistical routing
continues separately; credibility, copula, GAM and mixture methods operate on
the existing three experts, not as standalone replacement statistical models.

## Contribution to the existing three experts


Fresh matched outer predictions from TabPFN219, Kumo439 and LimiXtop100 were
combined on the same56k development applications. Their equal-weight mean has
pooled KS0.508871. A50% Causilo439 /50%
three-expert-mean probability blend reaches KS0.510197, AUC0.836592;
delta KS+0.001326, paired95% CI
[-0.001686, +0.003503]. This does not establish an additional
gain. All27 predefined view/weight/probability-logit-rank comparisons are saved
in `tables/causilo_development_ensembles.csv`; no audit labels selected weights.

Causilo439 and Kumo439 have within-class score correlations
0.976292 (48,394 non-defaults) and
0.977213 (7,606 defaults). This observed
redundancy is consistent with the small ensemble increment, but correlation alone
does not prove that no useful complementarity is possible. The standalone Causilo
submission remains a test candidate; it is not advertised as an improved four-
expert MoE. No embedding or extra router complexity is justified by these results.


## Additional regression-head diagnostic


The official regression checkpoint was also tested against the binary target,
with the same439 features,42k context,14k screening queries and eight members.
KS0.520562, AUC0.835519; versus classification,
delta KS+0.001246 and delta AUC
-0.001629. This is a single-screen diagnostic,
not a validated improvement. It is not promoted to the submission or the MoE.
A sigmoid bounds the regression conditional mean for score export, preserves
ranking and does not improve KS. These transformed scores are not calibrated
default probabilities; their log-loss must not be read as calibrated-PD quality.
The official runtime recovered from a temporary CUDA allocation failure through
adaptive batching, retaining all42k context rows and eight ensemble members.
