# Basket feature research

Verified source:100k applications,4,359,817 legitimate items,2,986,855 orders. Raw105 feature reconstruction difference0. Baseline169 columns and identities match. Audit checks236. No raw deletion.

Source is the supplied bundle, not a reconstruction of an unavailable report. Customer-window category spending entropy and mean within-order entropy measure different behaviors.

Eight conditional contrasts control matched-window spending/count, repayment timing, bureau,quarter and coverage. Entropy180 and90-day structure comparisons replicate atBH5%;entropy30/90 H1q≈.0532 is partial evidence. Category-changeL1 loses its association under these controls. This is association and overlap selection, not a causal effect.

Use EDA_INSIGHTS.md for exact rates,sample/event counts,intervals and model deltas. Entropy-count heatmaps show frequency and entropy are correlated; sparsecells are gray. Grey is not lowrisk. Compositional shift can look useful univariately while providing no independent signal under available coarse controls.

Matched4-fold LightGBM and pending nested foundation/MoE results are separate from original3-fold report. See CURRENT_FOLD_BENCHMARK.csv,FOUNDATION_SCREEN.csv andNESTED_MOE_RESULTS.csv when complete.

Max observed basket-feature PSI=0.00052873. All eight are below their sample-size-specific permutation95%null threshold. No material marginal drift was detected; this does not prove stable target relationships or conditional joint distribution.

Protocol:public train/test are customer-disjoint and share2025 origination cohorts. Development56k,withheld audit14k,4 folds with42k/14k. Inner expert context21k/query21k. A true12-month embargo cannot be evaluated with only2025 selected-cohort labels; default dates/extraction/censoring times are unavailable. Jan-Sep→Q4 is retrospective temporal stress,not proof of label availability for deployed future decisions.

Earlier projectEDA already inspected all labeled training rows. Currentaudit prevents direct tuning leakage in these new experiments but is not pristine externaldata. Feature view/EDA choices over development make nested model-selection uncertainty broader than conditional bootstrap.

Delivered submissions remain the earlier Causilo and originalMoE. No partial/new screen predictions replace them. TargetKS0.60 has not been reached.

data_optimization/EDA_INSIGHTS.md.text:
# Temuan analisis data yang diarahkan pada modeling

Analisis menggunakan56,000 development applications (7,606 defaults). Audit14k tidak dipakai untuk memilih hipotesis baru. H1 menentukan cuts dan transform; H2 adalah replikasi eksploratif pada data yang pernah dianalisis sebelumnya. Tidak ada klaim kausal atau pencapaian KS0.60.

### Insight 1: Timing alokasi membawa sinyal yang bertahan setelah kontrol

**Observation:** Repayment allocation timing; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 543/12,574 = 4.32% (Wilson95% CI 3.98%–4.69%); tinggi: 3,631/12,321 = 29.47% (Wilson95% CI 28.67%–30.28%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 108 strata: 6.08% vs 24.47%, delta +18.39 pp,95% CI[+17.46 pp,+19.32 pp]. MH OR5.401,95% CI[4.890,5.966]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing +18.68 pp/+18.11 pp.

**Interpretation:** Kecenderungan alokasi setelah jatuh tempo mungkin mencerminkan perilaku pembayaran. Timestamp terakhir tidak menjelaskan pelunasan, saldo utang aktual, atau DPD.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** rep_allocation_after_due_share = observed after-due allocations / all observed allocations; previous loans only, timestamps<cutoff.

**Validation:** Informasi sudah berada dalam benchmark439; asosiasi ini tidak mengukur delta KS individual.

**Caveats:** Kontrol: bur_score_mean + ec_spend_90d + declared_monthly_income + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** IMPLEMENT.

**Priority:** P0.

### Insight 2: Belanja tetap informatif setelah risiko tradisional dikontrol

**Observation:** Shopping intensity; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 1,063/18,528 = 5.74% (Wilson95% CI 5.41%–6.08%); tinggi: 4,327/18,695 = 23.15% (Wilson95% CI 22.55%–23.76%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 176 strata: 6.85% vs 20.42%, delta +13.57 pp,95% CI[+12.90 pp,+14.25 pp]. MH OR3.880,95% CI[3.602,4.180]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing +14.09 pp/+13.06 pp.

**Interpretation:** Aktivitas belanja dapat menjadi pengukuran tambahan atas perilaku atau kebutuhan pembiayaan. Tidak membuktikan bahwa belanja menyebabkan gagal bayar.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** ec_spend_90d = sum(order_total) on unique completed orders in(cutoff-90d,cutoff); cancelled orders excluded.

**Validation:** Informasi sudah berada dalam benchmark439; asosiasi ini tidak mengukur delta KS individual.

**Caveats:** Kontrol: bur_score_mean + rep_allocation_after_due_share + declared_monthly_income + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** IMPLEMENT.

**Priority:** P0.

### Insight 3: Beban angsuran lama dan baru lebih relevan daripada income sendiri

**Observation:** Combined contractual burden; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 1,333/11,841 = 11.26% (Wilson95% CI 10.70%–11.84%); tinggi: 2,981/18,294 = 16.29% (Wilson95% CI 15.77%–16.84%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 125 strata: 10.32% vs 17.82%, delta +7.51 pp,95% CI[+6.67 pp,+8.34 pp]. MH OR2.051,95% CI[1.878,2.240]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing +7.83 pp/+7.18 pp.

**Interpretation:** Pendapatan tersedia setelah kewajiban kontraktual mungkin berbeda walaupun income sama. Angsuran lama mengikuti jadwal kontrak, bukan utang aktual yang terverifikasi.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** adv_fin_total_installment_income = (scheduled active historical installments + proposed installment)/declared income; historical decisions<cutoff; missing when denominator unsafe.

**Validation:** Informasi sudah berada dalam benchmark439; asosiasi ini tidak mengukur delta KS individual.

**Caveats:** Kontrol: declared_monthly_income + bur_score_mean + rep_allocation_after_due_share + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** IMPLEMENT.

**Priority:** P0.

### Insight 4: Durasi tanpa alokasi teramati berbeda dari frekuensinya

**Observation:** Allocation aging; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 2,865/29,349 = 9.76% (Wilson95% CI 9.43%–10.11%); tinggi: 2,397/7,690 = 31.17% (Wilson95% CI 30.14%–32.21%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 36 strata: 15.68% vs 28.15%, delta +12.47 pp,95% CI[+11.38 pp,+13.56 pp]. MH OR2.254,95% CI[2.106,2.412]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing +13.67 pp/+11.22 pp.

**Interpretation:** Tagihan yang lebih lama tanpa alokasi dapat merepresentasikan tekanan atau perbedaan visibilitas historis. Jadwal yang baru jatuh tempo memiliki kesempatan observasi berbeda.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** opt_rep_null_age_mass_per_schedule = sum(amount_due*due_age_days*null_allocation)/sum(eligible amount_due); all due_date<cutoff; last allocation<cutoff.

**Validation:** cb_opt_rep:delta KS-0.001392,95% CI[-0.004877,+0.002576],2/4 folds positif; causilo_opt_rep_e8:delta KS-0.001418,95% CI[-0.003774,+0.001477],2/4 folds positif

**Caveats:** Kontrol: rep_no_allocation_share + rep_allocation_after_due_share + bur_score_mean + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** EXPERIMENT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 5: Recency relatif terhadap ritme pribadi mempunyai asosiasi kondisional

**Observation:** Customer-relative current shopping gap; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 360/2,568 = 14.02% (Wilson95% CI 12.73%–15.42%); tinggi: 213/2,647 = 8.05% (Wilson95% CI 7.07%–9.14%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 71 strata: 14.62% vs 7.81%, delta -6.80 pp,95% CI[-8.47 pp,-5.13 pp]. MH OR0.475,95% CI[0.394,0.574]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing -7.31 pp/-6.31 pp.

**Interpretation:** Jarak sejak transaksi terakhir memiliki arti berbeda bagi pelanggan rutin dan jarang berbelanja. Seleksi histori dan strata membatasi generalisasi.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** opt_ec_current_gap_percentile = fraction of earlier365d consecutive-order gaps <= cutoff-to-last-order gap; require>=4 gaps; unique completed orders only.

**Validation:** cb_opt_ec:delta KS-0.001548,95% CI[-0.004570,+0.002271],1/4 folds positif; causilo_opt_ec_e8:delta KS-0.002000,95% CI[-0.004685,+0.000559],1/4 folds positif

**Caveats:** Kontrol: ec_spend_90d + ec_recency_days + bur_score_mean + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** EXPERIMENT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 6: Lonjakan basket terakhir belum didukung setelah kontrol

**Observation:** Latest basket relative to earlier baskets; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 2,427/18,365 = 13.22% (Wilson95% CI 12.73%–13.71%); tinggi: 2,567/18,477 = 13.89% (Wilson95% CI 13.40%–14.40%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 203 strata: 13.88% vs 13.56%, delta -0.32 pp,95% CI[-1.00 pp,+0.36 pp]. MH OR0.971,95% CI[0.911,1.034]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing -0.54 pp/-0.11 pp.

**Interpretation:** Nilai basket terakhir relatif terhadap histori sendiri mungkin hanya variasi pembelian; data ini tidak mendukung penambahan aturan risiko otomatis.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** opt_ec_last_basket_vs_earlier_mean = latest completed order_total / mean earlier365d order_total;>=4 earlier orders, denominator>Rp1000; otherwise NaN.

**Validation:** cb_opt_ec:delta KS-0.001548,95% CI[-0.004570,+0.002271],1/4 folds positif; causilo_opt_ec_e8:delta KS-0.002000,95% CI[-0.004685,+0.000559],1/4 folds positif

**Caveats:** Kontrol: ec_spend_90d + ec_basket_mean + bur_score_mean + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** REJECT.

**Priority:** P2.

### Insight 7: Income besar tidak otomatis berarti kapasitas membayar lebih baik

**Observation:** Absolute declared income; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 2,378/18,567 = 12.81% (Wilson95% CI 12.33%–13.30%); tinggi: 2,621/18,473 = 14.19% (Wilson95% CI 13.69%–14.70%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 156 strata: 12.28% vs 14.76%, delta +2.48 pp,95% CI[+1.81 pp,+3.14 pp]. MH OR1.265,95% CI[1.187,1.349]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing +2.78 pp/+2.18 pp.

**Interpretation:** Asosiasi positif bersyarat dapat melibatkan jumlah pinjaman, kebijakan harga, seleksi debitur, serta pengukuran income. Tidak dapat diterjemahkan menjadi efek kausal pendapatan.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** Retain declared income alongside burden, loan amount and observed credits; do not impose a decreasing monotonic risk constraint.

**Validation:** Informasi sudah berada dalam benchmark439; asosiasi ini tidak mengukur delta KS individual.

**Caveats:** Kontrol: adv_fin_total_installment_income + bur_score_mean + rep_allocation_after_due_share + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** EXPERIMENT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 8: Ukuran keranjang perlu dipisahkan dari nilai belanja

**Observation:** Basket item count; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 2,415/19,150 = 12.61% (Wilson95% CI 12.15%–13.09%); tinggi: 2,304/16,652 = 13.84% (Wilson95% CI 13.32%–14.37%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 358 strata: 14.12% vs 12.53%, delta -1.59 pp,95% CI[-2.28 pp,-0.91 pp]. MH OR0.859,95% CI[0.804,0.918]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing -1.78 pp/-1.40 pp.

**Interpretation:** Jumlah item dapat berubah tanpa peningkatan nilai belanja; pola ini harus diuji, bukan diasumsikan menunjukkan distress.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** basket_items_mean_90d = mean(item row count per unique completed order); retain legitimate items; event<cutoff.

**Validation:** cb_opt_baskets:delta KS+0.002031,95% CI[-0.001996,+0.006176],2/4 folds positif; causilo_opt_baskets_e8:delta KS+0.000855,95% CI[-0.002491,+0.004085],2/4 folds positif

**Caveats:** Kontrol: ec_spend_90d + ec_basket_mean + ec_count_90d + bur_score_mean + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** EXPERIMENT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 9: Keranjang multi-category mempertahankan informasi yang hilang di cache spending

**Observation:** Multi-category baskets; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 2,220/18,030 = 12.31% (Wilson95% CI 11.84%–12.80%); tinggi: 2,347/17,171 = 13.67% (Wilson95% CI 13.16%–14.19%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 352 strata: 13.98% vs 12.01%, delta -1.97 pp,95% CI[-2.65 pp,-1.28 pp]. MH OR0.825,95% CI[0.771,0.883]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing -1.89 pp/-2.05 pp.

**Interpretation:** Pembelian lintas kategori dapat mengukur keragaman atau kebutuhan belanja; kategori literal tidak dikelompokkan sebagai essential/discretionary.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** basket_multi_category_share_90d = mean(distinct category count per completed order>1); unique order events<cutoff.

**Validation:** cb_opt_baskets:delta KS+0.002031,95% CI[-0.001996,+0.006176],2/4 folds positif; causilo_opt_baskets_e8:delta KS+0.000855,95% CI[-0.002491,+0.004085],2/4 folds positif

**Caveats:** Kontrol: ec_spend_90d + ec_basket_mean + ec_count_90d + bur_score_mean + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** EXPERIMENT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 10: Quantity tidak sama dengan jumlah baris item

**Observation:** Basket quantity; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 1,073/8,517 = 12.60% (Wilson95% CI 11.91%–13.32%); tinggi: 847/5,391 = 15.71% (Wilson95% CI 14.76%–16.71%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 178 strata: 15.38% vs 14.41%, delta -0.98 pp,95% CI[-2.27 pp,+0.31 pp]. MH OR0.919,95% CI[0.819,1.031]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing -1.84 pp/-0.21 pp.

**Interpretation:** Beberapa unit produk muncul pada satu baris; jangan mengalikan item_total kembali dengan quantity.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** basket_quantity_mean_90d = mean(sum item quantity per completed order); all events<cutoff.

**Validation:** cb_opt_baskets:delta KS+0.002031,95% CI[-0.001996,+0.006176],2/4 folds positif; causilo_opt_baskets_e8:delta KS+0.000855,95% CI[-0.002491,+0.004085],2/4 folds positif

**Caveats:** Kontrol: basket_items_mean_90d + ec_spend_90d + ec_basket_mean + bur_score_mean + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** REJECT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 11: Pergantian komposisi diuji pada dua periode yang punya cukup order

**Observation:** Category composition change; kelompok ekstrem ditetapkan oleh H1.

**Evidence:** Kelompok rendah: 1,483/5,922 = 25.04% (Wilson95% CI 23.96%–26.16%); tinggi: 1,086/4,971 = 21.85% (Wilson95% CI 20.72%–23.02%). Setelah standardisasi overlap pada 135 strata: 23.92% vs 22.61%, delta -1.31 pp,95% CI[-2.85 pp,+0.23 pp]. MH OR0.925,95% CI[0.841,1.016]. H1/H2 delta masing-masing -0.29 pp/-2.29 pp.

**Interpretation:** Divergensi kategori dapat mencerminkan kebutuhan yang berubah atau variasi sampel;>=3 order di kedua sisi mengurangi rasio tidak stabil.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** basket_category_mix_jsd_30v90 = Jensen-Shannon(category spending shares30d,prior90d)/log(2);>=3 completed orders and positive spending each; cutoff-safe.

**Validation:** cb_opt_baskets:delta KS+0.002031,95% CI[-0.001996,+0.006176],2/4 folds positif; causilo_opt_baskets_e8:delta KS+0.000855,95% CI[-0.002491,+0.004085],2/4 folds positif

**Caveats:** Kontrol: ec_spend_90d + ec_count_90d + ec_basket_mean + bur_score_mean + quarter + internal-history coverage. Bukan estimasi kausal; hanya strata dengan>=10 baris pada kedua kelompok. CI risk difference bersyarat pada strata dan weights. H2 pernah terlihat dalam riset terdahulu.

**Decision:** REJECT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 12: Sinyal repayment dan shopping bertumpang tindih secara nonlinear

**Observation:** Interaksi rep_allocation_after_due_share × ec_spend_90d bertahan dalam additive spline controls.

**Evidence:** H1 n=28,028,events=3,806,beta=-1.9095,95% CI[-2.6231,-1.1959],BH q=4.77e-07. H2 n=27,972,events=3,800,beta=-1.5276,CI[-2.2213,-0.8339],q=4.56e-05. Beta berlaku untuk produk dua rank berpusat, bukan unit asli.

**Interpretation:** Interaksi positif dapat menunjukkan hubungan yang menguat; interaksi negatif menunjukkan penyimpangan di bawah penjumlahan log-odds model aditif. Itu tidak berarti kelompok dua sinyal tinggi menjadi aman.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** opt_int_rank_product_1=(F_context(rep_allocation_after_due_share)-.5)*(F_context(ec_spend_90d)-.5). Fit empirical CDF pada training context; component PIT; undefined stays NaN with indicator.

**Validation:** cb_opt_interactions:delta KS-0.000596,CI[-0.002897,+0.003905]; causilo_opt_interactions_e8:delta KS-0.001042,CI[-0.003362,+0.001921]

**Caveats:** Delapan pasangan prespecified, BH hanya mencakup keluarga ini; banyak analisis terdahulu belum masuk koreksi. Hipotesis dipilih pada development; CV tidak menjadi konfirmasi buta.

**Decision:** EXPERIMENT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 13: Banyak histori mengubah arti proporsi alokasi terlambat

**Observation:** Interaksi rep_due_count × rep_allocation_after_due_share bertahan dalam additive spline controls.

**Evidence:** H1 n=28,028,events=3,806,beta=4.2876,95% CI[2.9900,5.5852],BH q=2.69e-10. H2 n=27,972,events=3,800,beta=4.4627,CI[3.1573,5.7681],q=4.93e-11. Beta berlaku untuk produk dua rank berpusat, bukan unit asli.

**Interpretation:** Interaksi positif dapat menunjukkan hubungan yang menguat; interaksi negatif menunjukkan penyimpangan di bawah penjumlahan log-odds model aditif. Itu tidak berarti kelompok dua sinyal tinggi menjadi aman.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** opt_int_rank_product_4=(F_context(rep_due_count)-.5)*(F_context(rep_allocation_after_due_share)-.5). Fit empirical CDF pada training context; component PIT; undefined stays NaN with indicator.

**Validation:** cb_opt_interactions:delta KS-0.000596,CI[-0.002897,+0.003905]; causilo_opt_interactions_e8:delta KS-0.001042,CI[-0.003362,+0.001921]

**Caveats:** Delapan pasangan prespecified, BH hanya mencakup keluarga ini; banyak analisis terdahulu belum masuk koreksi. Hipotesis dipilih pada development; CV tidak menjadi konfirmasi buta.

**Decision:** EXPERIMENT.

**Priority:** P1.

### Insight 14: Histori internal kosong tetap menjadi segmen lebih sulit

**Observation:** Pemisahan risiko lebih lemah tanpa histori internal.

**Evidence:** Tanpa histori n=16,749,events=1,992,rate=11.89%,Wilson CI[11.41%,12.39%],OOF KS0.469508. Dengan histori n=39,251,events=5,614,rate=14.30%,CI[13.96%,14.65%],KS0.527691.

**Interpretation:** Evidence availability membatasi pemisahan; beda KS belum membuktikan interaksi kausal atau kebutuhan model terpisah.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** Preserve acc_missing,prev_missing,rep_due_count,bur_provider_count and observed exposure. Jangan menyebut tidak ada histori internal sebagai new-to-credit.

**Validation:** OOF source estimates; model coverage khusus pada riset sebelumnya tidak memberi gain konsisten.

**Caveats:** Ukuran/prevalensi segmen berbeda; tidak ada CI delta segment KS pada tabel ini.

**Decision:** IMPLEMENT coverage flags; EXPERIMENT additional external evidence.

**Priority:** P0.

### Insight 15: Interaksi intuitif perlu bukti replikasi

**Observation:** 3/8 pasangan tidak memenuhi syarat sign yang sama dan q<.05 pada H1/H2.

**Evidence:** ec_recency_days × ec_spend_90d:qH1=0.08649,qH2=0.2569,same_sign=False; adv_fin_total_installment_income × declared_monthly_income:qH1=0.1129,qH2=0.08566,same_sign=True; opt_ec_current_gap_percentile × ec_spend_90d:qH1=0.3057,qH2=0.4078,same_sign=False. Sampel dan event counts tersedia di INTERACTION_TESTS.csv.

**Interpretation:** Hubungan marginal kuat tidak menjamin interaction term berguna setelah main effects nonlinear dikontrol.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** Jangan mengunci recency × spending sebagai pola terbukti; pertahankan main effects dan bandingkan interaction groups.

**Validation:** Belum ada bukti gain khusus untuk pasangan gagal replikasi.

**Caveats:** Tidak signifikan bukan bukti efek tepat nol; fungsi spline atau skala lain dapat mengubah tes.

**Decision:** REJECT promotion of these interactions as established discoveries.

**Priority:** P2.

### Insight 16: Pergeseran train/test kecil pada representasi yang diuji

**Observation:** PSI terbesar dari fitur yang diuji adalah 0.001118 (adv_fin_total_installment_income).

**Evidence:** Development n=56,000,test n=30,000; null PSI95=0.000879 dari200 conditional permutations. Missingness 0.00% vs 0.00%. Missing proportions tidak melibatkan target test.

**Interpretation:** Pergeseran yang terdeteksi secara statistik dapat tetap kecil secara praktis pada sampel besar.

**Feature Engineering Opportunity:** Gunakan bins fit pada H1 untuk monitor drift, serta flags/denominator historis; jangan mengandalkan threshold PSI universal.

**Validation:** Distribution comparison only; tidak membuktikan kestabilan feature-target atau KS pada hidden test.

**Caveats:** Hanya distribusi observed features; outcome drift tidak bisa diuji tanpa label test.

**Decision:** IMPLEMENT monitoring.

**Priority:** P1.

data_optimization/EDA_REPORT.md.text:
# Optimasi analisis dan representasi data

Round ini memisahkan asosiasi, bentuk hubungan, kestabilan, dan kontribusi tambahan pada KS. 57 cached features berasal dari aging alokasi, perilaku shopping relatif pelanggan, dan audited basket composition bila sudah tersedia. Lima interaksi diperoleh dari8 pasangan yang diuji diH1/H2;10 columns termasuk undefined indicators dibuat per training context. Seluruh100,000 aplikasi mempunyai availability matrix; hanya56k development labels dipakai untuk pola baru. Detail item/order invariants ada di DUPLICATE_AUDIT.md.

Data:70k train/30k test;9,507 train defaults; selected customers unique/disjoint; kedua split mencakup2025. Sumber memiliki1,361,341 eligible historical installments dan2,093,383 completed orders dalam365d untuk round ini. Histori internal kosong tidak sama dengan tidak punya kredit eksternal. Parent EDA dan dictionary menjadi provenance.

Numerical tables: TARGET_BINS.csv uses fixedH1 quantile cuts and Wilson95% CIs acrossH1/H2/Q1–Q4; CONDITIONAL_ASSOCIATIONS.csv reports overlap-weighted risk differences and MH odds ratios controlling income/bureau/repayment/quarter/coverage as applicable. Exposure groups drop the middle tertile and sparse strata, so estimates describe the remaining overlap population. These strata only coarsely control continuous variables.

INTERACTION_TESTS.csv tests centered-rank products over additive splines of15 continuous controls plus categorical employment,housing,region,purpose and season terms. CDF/spline fit onH1; the two phases fit separate models. Repayment age/history, coverage, contractual pricing, loan amount and age are included. BH correction covers only8 prespecified pairs, not all earlier project analyses. Five pairs replicate with the same sign and q<.05. Three do not. Inference is observational.

![Observed risk rates by exposure and allocation timing](figures/repayment_interactions.png)

The heatmap answers whether equal lateness shares behave similarly across histories/shopping levels. Cells give exact events/rows. Colors require>=200 rows and>=20 events; rates are raw, while GLM tests separately adjust controls. Do not interpret a negative interaction coefficient as low risk for two individually high-risk signals.

## Matched feature experiments

| model | reference | ks | auc | delta_ks | paired_ci_low | paired_ci_high | positive_folds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cb_opt_rep | cb_all | 0.499409 | 0.829202 | -0.001392 | -0.004877 | 0.002576 | 2 |
| cb_opt_ec | cb_all | 0.499252 | 0.829231 | -0.001548 | -0.004570 | 0.002271 | 1 |
| cb_opt_all | cb_all | 0.501093 | 0.828877 | 0.000293 | -0.002734 | 0.004244 | 2 |
| cb_opt_interactions | cb_all | 0.500205 | 0.829702 | -0.000596 | -0.002897 | 0.003905 | 2 |
| cb_opt_baskets | cb_all | 0.502831 | 0.829942 | 0.002031 | -0.001996 | 0.006176 | 2 |
| causilo_opt_rep_e8 | causilo_all_e8 | 0.509556 | 0.834836 | -0.001418 | -0.003774 | 0.001477 | 2 |
| causilo_opt_ec_e8 | causilo_all_e8 | 0.508974 | 0.835234 | -0.002000 | -0.004685 | 0.000559 | 1 |
| causilo_opt_all_e8 | causilo_all_e8 | 0.508567 | 0.834920 | -0.002407 | -0.004775 | 0.000928 | 0 |
| causilo_opt_interactions_e8 | causilo_all_e8 | 0.509932 | 0.834915 | -0.001042 | -0.003362 | 0.001921 | 1 |
| causilo_opt_baskets_e8 | causilo_all_e8 | 0.511829 | 0.836047 | 0.000855 | -0.002491 | 0.004085 | 2 |

Reference models use439 existing audited features. New candidates use the same four development folds (42k training/14k validation), locked parameters and seed. Causilo uses8 members and no context sampling; CatBoost uses600 trees/depth5/lr.035/L2=8. Paired bootstrap500 resamples describes conditional uncertainty. Model/view selection and globally explored development labels make these selection diagnostics, not fully blind outer estimates. The stronger starting model can already represent a pattern discovered in EDA; high univariate KS is not evidence of unique predictive value.

No new audit scores are used to pick these groups. Causilo's earlier439 candidate was locked before its audit and has validated KS0.520437/AUC0.842323, versus matched CatBoost baseline KS0.501939. Its completed30k-row submission_causilo.csv is retained. A new feature group is not promoted based on a single screen or a positive0.001 fluctuation.

## Error and drift implications

OOF_ERROR_SEGMENTS.csv compares segments using held-out predictions, never in-sample fit scores. No-history Causilo KS0.469508 versus with-history0.527691 indicates weaker available evidence; these are different segment populations. OOF_SCORE_DECILES.csv locates score-distribution overlap. Segment values have no claim of causal effect or formal significance of KS differences.

TRAIN_TEST_DRIFT.csv usesH1 bins and200 conditional null permutations. Largest observed PSI0.001118; train/test distributions are close on these measured dimensions. This does not establish no label drift or no leakage. Temporal coverage and null-source flags remain explicit.

See EDA_INSIGHTS.md for16 supported/qualified findings, FEATURE_HYPOTHESES.md for negative results, FEATURE_CATALOG.csv for exact implementation, FEATURE_EXPERIMENTS.csv for paired KS decisions, and MODELING_ROADMAP.md for priorities. Execute scripts31→32→33→34;33 --queue runs group CV,33 --interaction-queue runs replicated interactions. Old research outputs and CSVs are preserved. KS0.60 remains unachieved.

# Domain-led research

The objective is public KS >=0.57; this is a target, not an achieved score. Every trained model must retain settings, fold predictions, checkpoint/preprocessing, results and a submission CSV.

1. Purchasing power versus spending strain: isolate unit price from category composition and shopping exposure. The first conditional association remains positive in H1/Q4; category-adjusted sensitivity and matched model ablation decide whether it adds information.

# E-commerce velocity and cross-source experiments

User additions: spending velocity, e-commerce behavior, and cross-source feature engineering after the adapter baseline has been tested. Original Kumo weights remain100% frozen; only the requested new adapter learns.

## Mechanisms to test

1. Recent purchasing pressure: recorded completed spending per day and unique orders per day over7,14,30days. A burst may reflect liquidity demand, purchasing capacity, or an observation artifact; its direction is tested rather than assumed.
2. Acceleration versus magnitude: compare last7days with the preceding23days and last30days with the preceding30days. Compare daily rates, not unequal-window sums. Separate frequency growth from average basket value.
3. Financial mismatch: compare shopping and bank inflows within exactly the same completed account months. Contrast shopping growth with inflow/income-credit growth only when all six required months are observed. Missing history is not zero financial capacity.
4. Funding pressure: compare credit-card order share with equal-provider latest eligible bureau utilization; compare spending acceleration with safe historical allocation-after-due frequency. Neither provider exposure nor bank outflows are added again as if independent debts.

Fixed-window spending divided by a constant has identical ordering to its raw sum. The research tests new windows, changes, and conditional relationships; it does not claim that merely renaming spending as velocity creates new information.

## Feature definitions

- Spend velocity: `sum(unique completed order_total where0<decision-event<=w days)/w`, forw=7,14,30. Unit:IDR/day.
- Order velocity: `count(unique completed orders in same window)/w`. Unit:orders/day.
- Spend acceleration ratio: `(S_recent/recent_days)/(S_prior/prior_days)`. A zero prior rate givesNaN plus an explicit prior-zero indicator.
- Bounded growth: `(rate_recent-rate_prior)/(rate_recent+rate_prior)`. No activity in either window givesNaN.
- Active-day share: occupied24h buckets anchored at the decision, divided by window days. This avoids counting8 calendar dates inside7elapsed days.
- Mean basket: completed spending / completed order count. Cancelled baskets contribute to cancellation frequency only.
- Financial alignment: monthly ecommerce spending / inflows summed over the same observed account months among the3complete months before decision. The6month growth contrast requires3recent and3prior account months.
- Monthly-equivalent velocity / declared income: `spend_velocity*30.4375/declared_monthly_income`; this is an equivalent rate, not an assertion about a future full month's actual spending.

All ratios with nonpositive/near-zero denominators remain missing. First recorded activity measures observed depth, not a proven start of data coverage. The source item table is preserved; the226-feature baseline still contains its57basket/item features.

## Execution and validation

EDA and point-in-time aggregation run while adapter testing is active. Feature-model training waits for `ADAPTER_PIPELINE.json: COMPLETE`.

|lightgbm__ec_velocity_cross|Baseline226 + both|Both baseline and velocity-only|Unique cross-source contribution|
|kumo_adapter__ec_velocity|Baseline226 + velocity|Kumo adapter baseline226|Foundation-model utility|
|kumo_adapter__ec_velocity_cross|Baseline226 + both|Both adapter baseline and velocity-only|Combined representation|

Q4 is previously examined development data, not an untouched final test. No gains are claimed before training results exist.

# Additive transfer from notebooks01–10 into Kumo Small + adapter

The anchor is the existing price/bureau adapter experiment:226 original features
plus56 price and10 bureau-history features. These292 input columns, all metadata,
and every existing experiment remain intact. All27,458,266 original Kumo weights
are frozen; only the existing16,912-parameter adapter is optimized.

The original notebooks in `/home/taqiyudinmiftah/Logika/notebooks` are read-only
references. No original notebook is executed or modified. Notebook10's public
0.56262 belongs to its frozen Kumo Large V5 submission, not its spline blend or
our Small adapter. Different folds, context bagging and inputs prevent directly
equating that score with our local validation.

|Variant|Additions to preserved292 inputs|Comparison|
|---|---|---|
|nb_observed|All-history category-relative completed prices; cancelled/pooled basket preference; order completion smoothing; bureau-history/current-application score summaries; remaining contractual installment burden; missing30/60-day shopping summaries|Price/bureau adapter|
|nb_latent|Above plus category/customer price GLS and uncertainty, provider-adjusted bureau GLS and uncertainty, log-income consistency, mature allocation-timing rates and Beta-Binomial uncertainty|Price/bureau adapter; also inspect incremental difference versus nb_observed|
|nb_snapshot_dpd|Above plus notebook maturity-adjusted actual historical DPD and paid-ratio features; snapshot-assumed diagnostic|Price/bureau adapter and nb_latent; excluded from trusted recommendations until servicing provenance is established|

Existing features are reused rather than renamed: proposed installment/income,
repayment coverage and allocation-after-due rate,90/180-day spending, current
bureau summaries, cash-flow trends, and57 basket/item features already exist.
The earlier velocity and cross-source experiments remain available independently;
they are not silently substituted into this fixed292-column anchor.

## What the DPD notebooks actually do

Earlier notebooks aggregate historical `days_past_due`, `max_days_past_due` and
`amount_paid` on earlier loans, not the selected loan's future target. V3 applies
historical-event smoothing. V4 adds threshold maturity, equal-loan weighting,
last12-installment rates and half-life weighting. Notebook10 estimates
Beta-Binomial priors for thresholds1/7/30 and computes posterior mean and SD.
Our transfer also tests the V4 threshold90 and equal-loan rates, where each
historical loan contributes equally instead of being weighted by installment count.

For threshold t, an installment enters the denominator only when due-age>=t.
With k events and n eligible installments, posterior mean=(k+alpha)/(n+alpha+beta)
and posterior SD=sqrt((k+alpha)(n-k+beta)/((n+alpha+beta)^2(n+alpha+beta+1))).
The fixed-strength last12 rate is (k12+12*p)/(n12+12). The decayed rate is
(sum(exp(-log(2)*age/90)*event)+6*p)/(sum(exp(-log(2)*age/90))+6).
All alpha,beta and p are estimated only from historical events in fit customers;
selected-loan targets are never used for these priors.

The trusted timing branch substitutes an explicitly named allocation proxy:
max(calendar(last_allocation)-calendar(due),0), or calendar(cutoff)-calendar(due)
if no allocation is recorded. This is not labeled actual DPD or settlement delay.
The direct-DPD branch retains the notebooks' snapshot assumption explicitly.
See NOTEBOOK_DPD_SOURCE_AUDIT.json for actual consistency counts; consistency
alone does not independently prove that a retrospective field was available.

## Validation and implementation differences

- Identical existing3 outer folds and Q4 future holdout; same customer-disjoint
  contexts, pretrained checkpoint, seeds, inner-only early stopping and estimators.
- Each inner/outer scope gets its own category/provider references, empirical
  priors and measurement-noise estimates. Notebook10's global training references
  and all-account income-noise fit are replaced with fold-local fits.
- Bureau requires report AND availability<=cutoff; account months must be fully
  completed. Historical loan FK/customer ownership and prior decision are checked.
- Cancelled basket values describe intended prices; they never enter completed
  purchase spending. Orders are counted once and valid item rows remain available.
- Safe division leaves undefined ratios missing. No-history n=0 is explicit;
  posterior mean then equals the fitted prior with its corresponding uncertainty.
- Every completed variant saves OOF/Q4 predictions, paired bootstrap intervals,
  checkpoint, matching assertions, input references and a separate submission CSV.
- Synthetic held-out perturbation tests ensure reference estimates cannot change
  when validation/test prices or scores change. Full-cache assertions verify every
  existing feature value remains exactly unchanged.

Increasing feature count is a test, not evidence of improvement. Negative results
remain logged. Public score is unknown until the user submits a generated CSV.

# Queued account-tail features on the latent/spline branch

Authorized after the existing32 candidates finish and both independent audits
pass. Supervisor mode only waits until CREATIVE and WAVE2 are COMPLETE with
matching audit PASS. No existing GPU process or notebook is changed.

Four prespecified candidates, all on the same five folds seed31027:

- cre_act_coverage:3 account observation-depth/freshness inputs only.
- cre_act_cvar:coverage plus two lower-tail20percent cash-margin inputs.
- cre_act_downside:coverage plus six semideviation/drawdown/shortfall inputs.
- cre_act_all:the fixed union,11 additional spline inputs.

Every candidate reuses the same frozen Kumo100 validation/test predictions from
large_basket_domain_both, checked against training/validation/checkpoint hashes.
Only spline87 is refitted with its new inputs. Original C=0.05, five knots,
newton-cholesky solver and4 CPU threads are retained. Blend remains75:25;
no feature selection or blend tuning on outer validation. Two CPU fits maximum
run concurrently; this batch has zero GPU training jobs.

Monthly cash margin=(inflows-outflows-proposed installment)/proposed installment.
Only month+one calendar month<=decision cutoff is eligible. Selected installment
must be positive. Missing measurements are excluded, not filled before aggregation.
No ecommerce or old installment payments are subtracted again from outflows.
Fixed6/12calendar-month windows need at least6 measured months for tail statistics.
Counts/freshness remain explicit; undefined derived values stay missing.

Tail mean integrates exactly the bottom20percent probability mass, including a
fractional boundary month. Downside semideviation is sqrt(mean(min(margin,0)^2)).
Drawdown is maximum running-peak minus closing balance within consecutive observed
month segments, divided by installment. It is not a reconstructed daily path.
Liquidity shortfall is mean(max(installment-minimum_balance,0)/installment).
Effective tail masses are saved for audit but not duplicated as model inputs.

Each candidate exports70000-row OOF, fold KS/AUC, paired bootstrap300 versus the
original0.529687612835 reference, spline checkpoint and30000-row submission CSV.
Final audit verifies source Kumo predictions stayed identical, exact blend replay,
customer/fold isolation, output IDs/probabilities/SHA, and paired comparisons with
the coverage-only control. Shared EXPERIMENT_LOG.csv records completed candidates.
No new performance gain is assumed. Snapshot provenance inherited from the
reference remains UNVERIFIED; reused development CV is not untouched confirmation.

Entry point: scripts/actuarial_spline.py supervise. Status:
reports/ACTUARIAL_PIPELINE.json; results: reports/ACTUARIAL_EXPERIMENTS.csv.

- Basket adds+0.000276495 pooled KS; paired CI versus corrected baseline is[-0.001199567,+0.001528629], with3/5 fold wins.

## Yang dipelajari dari baseline, domain dan basket

- foldlocal vs domain_interactions: Spearman0.99980822, rata-rata beda probabilitas0.001888. Prediksi sangat mirip; bobot ensemble yang lebih rumit membutuhkan bukti komplementaritas yang lebih kuat.

- Jumlah kasus yang membaik pada satu expert tidak cukup membuktikan spesialisasi: tanda perubahan log-loss bisa berubah karena pergeseran skor sangat kecil. Segmentasi harus dinilai dengan effect size dan interval ketidakpastian.
- Entropy setelah koreksi baseline_activity: n=51132, KSraw=0.174685, KSresidual=0.042351, AUCresidual=0.498312, R2prediksi entropy held-out=0.5345. Regresi nuisance hanya memakai fitur training-fold dan tidak memakai target default.
- Entropy setelah koreksi baseline_activity_and_lifetime_entropy: n=51132, KSraw=0.174685, KSresidual=0.020842, AUCresidual=0.496753, R2prediksi entropy held-out=0.5648. Regresi nuisance hanya memakai fitur training-fold dan tidak memakai target default.
- Ini mengindikasikan redundansi marginal entropy dengan fitur aktivitas/entropy yang sudah ada. Hasil residual bukan bukti kausal, bukan uji kontribusi multivariat penuh, dan hanya berlaku pada51.132 aplikasi dengan entropy30 hari teramati.
- domain_interactions pada repayment_0: n=23688, events=2878, deltaKS=+0.000089, CI95%[-0.001912,+0.001711].
- basket pada repayment_0: n=23688, events=2878, deltaKS=+0.001512, CI95%[-0.001510,+0.004179].
- domain_interactions pada repayment_7plus: n=39728, events=5629, deltaKS=+0.000577, CI95%[-0.001260,+0.001968].
- basket pada repayment_7plus: n=39728, events=5629, deltaKS=-0.000196, CI95%[-0.002068,+0.001507].
- Seluruh interval segmen ini masih melintasi nol. Kelompok tanpa repayment internal tidak boleh otomatis disebut new-to-credit, karena mereka tetap dapat memiliki histori bureau.

## Prioritas eksperimen berikutnya

1. Selesaikan uji penempatan interaksi di Kumo100. Ini memisahkan manfaat representasi foundation model dari tambahan kurva pada spline. Jangan menganggap gabungan fitur selalu menambah informasi.
2. Uji sedikit interaksi yang memperhitungkan kelengkapan histori, misalnya basket entropy × indikator tanpa repayment internal, dan price-pressure × indikator account tersedia. Perbedaan segmen saat ini masih eksploratif. Router yang dipelajari membutuhkan inner-OOF di dalam setiap outer fold; jangan belajar bobot dari error outer-validation ini.
3. Uji probabilitas affordability dengan uncertainty: Phi((log(proposed_installment/0.4)-mu_log_income)/sd_log_income_measurement). Nilai ini merepresentasikan ketidakpastian latent mean income, bukan peluang pendapatan aktual bulan depan. Missing income tetap missing; sd0 ditangani dengan limit indikator yang eksplisit. Ini hipotesis fitur, belum diuji pada model penuh.
4. Turunkan prioritas menambah lebih banyak versi entropy agregat. Kandidat residual yang sudah dibuat perlu pembuktian incremental; KS marginalnya lemah setelah aktivitas/lifetime entropy diperhitungkan. Perubahan komposisi per kategori yang dikaitkan dengan kapasitas finansial lebih layak menjadi hipotesis terbatas daripada menambah banyak agregat serupa.

Semua keputusan selanjutnya perlu fold identik, pengulangan seed terkontrol, dan evaluasi temporal dengan keterbatasan penggunaan ulang development data yang dinyatakan. Snapshot DPD/paid warisan resep awal tetap belum terverifikasi. Tidak ada notebook asli yang diubah.

# Domain and basket combination: locked before results

Three matched experiments use the original five folds, seed31027,50,000 context
rows per fold, eight estimators, and the original75% Kumo /25% spline recipe.
Kumo weights remain100% frozen. Existing fold-local features are reused.

|ID|Candidate|Kumo inputs|Spline inputs|New fitting|
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
|LR11|basket_domain: exact feature union|96|87|Five new splines; reuse the identical cached basket Kumo|
|LR12|basket_domain_both: expose interactions to Kumo|100|87|Five Kumo contexts; reuse the same LR11 splines|
|LR13|domain_basket_equal_blend|Existing experts|Existing experts|None; prespecified50:50 average of domain and basket predictions|

The six basket features enter both branches. The four domain interactions enter
only the spline in LR11, exactly as in the previous individual experiments. LR12
tests whether their availability to the foundation model makes a difference.
The frozen Kumo checkpoint SHA, unchanged-weight checks, context hashes, feature
lists and source prediction checksums are saved. Physical allocation is capped
at40% for the100-column worker while the original SDK logical chunk budget is
preserved exactly. Two independent CPU workers fit LR11 folds concurrently.

Every candidate is compared with baseline, domain-only and basket-only using
identical OOF rows and300 paired stratified bootstrap samples. LR12 is also
compared with LR11. Report pooled KS, AUC, mean/std fold KS, per-fold deltas and
conditional confidence intervals. Each completed candidate exports its own
30,000-row submission. No public-score claims or outer-validation weight tuning.

Parallel research uses only the three existing OOF predictions: correlations,
held-out loss improvement overlap, coverage/burden/basket segments and fold score
scales. A training-fold nuisance regression tests whether entropy largely tracks
purchase activity. It predicts historical entropy from log order count, log
spend and basket structure, without the default target. Its residual is an
unvalidated candidate; its univariate association is not a full-model gain.

Legacy DPD/paid snapshot provenance remains unverified in these information-set
comparisons. No new outcome columns are introduced and no original notebook is
modified. All work stays under the authorized `adit` workspace.

# Small source-wise latent modelling followups

User authorized all four proposals. Queue after LATENT_EMBEDDING is COMPLETE and
its independent audit PASS. Keep frozen Kumo100,frozen spline87,existing latent
statistics,the five outer folds and the already specified inner-holdout protocol.
No foundation model retraining or additional GPU fits. At most two CPU workers.

| Candidate | Intervention | Matched control |
|---|---|---|
| cre_le_domains | Four source-specific2D encoders,concatenated8D | original cre_le_emb8 |
| cre_le_domaincross | Same encoders plus two rank2 projected interaction pairs | cre_le_domains |
| cre_le_domaingate | Same cross model plus bounded sample-specific correction amplitude | cre_le_domaincross |
| cre_le_seedavg | Equal probability average of original global8D head and two extra head seeds | original cre_le_emb8 |

All candidates anchor to the exact existing75% frozen Kumo +25% frozen spline
score. The new three domain architectures are each under1,000 trainable
parameters; raw information is identical to the original global embedding head.

## Architecture

Route each of the24 input statistics/coverage values and its missing indicator
to exactly one source encoder. Price:five price latent statistics plus order
count. Bureau:three bureau latent statistics. Income:six income statistics plus
account-presence flag. Repayment:six posterior mean/SD statistics plus repayment
presence and installment count. Every encoder is Linear8→GELU→Dropout.1→Linear2.
The four2D outputs concatenate to8D. The two standardized Kumo/spline logits
enter the fusion head separately. Final residual layer starts at zero.

For the cross variant,learn two2×2 projection matrices per prescribed pair:
price-income and bureau-repayment. Elementwise products add two coordinates per
pair,four total. This is a small custom bilinear interaction block inspired by
low-rank feature crossing,not a reproduction of the full DCN-V2 architecture.

The gate variant retains those pairs. A linear sigmoid gate receives existing
posterior/measurement SD inputs,available coverage/counts,their missing flags,
and the absolute difference between standardized expert logits. It scales the
bounded correction:delta=alpha×gate(x)×tanh(head). Gate in[0,1],alpha selected from
0,.1,.25 on inner meta-validation. No predetermined sign is imposed on uncertainty;
large uncertainty is not assumed automatically to imply low risk or uselessness.
The implementation uses an equivalent effective raw score so the unchanged
residual runner can enforce the same prediction/bounding API. Gate diagnostics
are saved by fold and evaluated on held-out/test rows.

The three-seed experiment uses the original monolithic8D architecture,not an
outer-CV-selected architecture. Reuse its original checkpoint/predictions and
train seeds +1000,+2000 with the identical data/preprocessing/selection recipe.
Each member selects its own stopping epoch and correction bound on the same
inner meta-validation rows. Fixed equal weights; average probabilities through
baseline+mean(member-baseline) to preserve exact zero-correction baselines.
Never average embedding axes across independently trained members or folds.
Extra seeds are ensemble members,not separately selected submission candidates.

## Isolation and reproducibility

Reuse latent_residual.py's exact preprocessing,loss,optimizer,early stopping,
alpha selection and refit. A scoped constructor injection selects only the new
network class in the current worker process; the original module on disk and
other queued workers are unchanged. Record and read back both source files.
Kumo and spline source prediction/checkpoint SHA must remain identical.

Head training uses the existing11,200 held-out inner predictions per outer fold;
inner Kumo/reference fit44,800 customers,outer Kumo context50,000. Epoch/bound
selection splits head rows80:20 and refits the selected head on all11,200.
This is a genuine holdout subset,not full inner-OOF for the56,000 outer-training
rows. The context/reference-population mismatch remains an explicit limitation.
No outer validation labels train encoders,gates,stopping rules or blend weights.

Every candidate exports70,000 OOF rows,KS/AUC,delta KS,300 paired-bootstrap95%
intervals,fold dispersion,per-fold checkpoints and its own30,000-row submission
CSV. Seed members also retain checkpoints,predictions,selection traces and
per-fold individual KS variability. Report matched architecture comparisons in
DOMAIN_EMBEDDING_ARTIFACT_AUDIT.json; maintain DOMAIN_EMBEDDING_EXPERIMENTS.csv,
EXPERIMENT_LOG.csv and DOMAIN_EMBEDDING_INSIGHTS.md. Replay actual checkpoints,
IDs/source hashes,context/meta disjointness,exact ensemble arithmetic and final
CSV ordering/checksums. No automatic Kaggle submission or winner promotion.

CV folds are reused development data. CI excludes retraining/selection effects.
Legacy repayment snapshot provenance remains UNVERIFIED; no new raw DPD/paid
derivatives or point-in-time certification are introduced.

Background: [DCN-V2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.13535),
[Deep Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/1612.01474).
These motivate hypotheses,not a promised KS gain on this dataset.

# Latent residual embedding queue

Requested scope: retain the existing latent/statistical feature construction,
frozen Kumo100 and frozen spline87. Add a small trainable residual layer only.
Start after NEXT_BATCH completes all CV candidates and its temporal stress check,
with both artifact audits PASS. Run at most two CPU workers; no new GPU fits.

| Candidate | Change | Control |
|---|---|---|
| cre_le_control | Exact cached Kumo75/spline25 outputs; no training | original baseline |
| cre_le_linear | Bounded linear residual from the same inputs | cre_le_control |
| cre_le_emb8 | Small nonlinear encoder to8D, then fusion head | control and linear |
| cre_le_emb16 | Same encoder/head recipe with16D embedding | control and linear |

Inputs: the existing20 latent columns, including posterior location/uncertainty
for price,bureau,income,repayment; four coverage columns (account presence,
repayment presence,installment count,completed30d order count). No new raw-table
derivatives. Numeric signed-log transform, median imputation, standardization and
all24 missing indicators; numeric standardized values clipped to±8. Kumo and
spline logits are separate fusion inputs. All fitted preprocessing is fold-local.

Network:48 latent/coverage/missing inputs → Linear32 → GELU → Dropout.1 →
Linear8/16 → concatenate the two standardized expert logits → Linear8 → GELU →
Dropout.1 → Linear1. Linear control consumes the same50 transformed inputs.
Final linear weights/bias start at zero. Kumo and spline weights/checkpoints are
unchanged; only the new encoder/head uses an optimizer. The20 latent numerical
statistics remain the information source for the learned embedding.

Final prediction:
`sigmoid(logit(clip(p_base,1e-6,1-1e-6)) + alpha*tanh(head))`, where
`p_base=.75*p_kumo+.25*p_spline`. Alpha is selected from0,.1,.25 using inner
meta-validation BCE. If selected improvement is below1e-5,BCE chooses alpha0.
Alpha0 or an exactly zero residual returns original probabilities directly to
preserve endpoint values and bit-exact baseline predictions. Clipping affects
nonzero corrections at exact0/1 and is recorded as a tie/numerical limitation.

## Genuine nested data use

Use existing, independently audited inner experts in each of the five outer
folds: Kumo100 fitted on44,800 inner-training customers, queried on11,200 disjoint
inner-holdout customers. Cached C=.05/5-knot spline87 predictions come from that
same44,800 training/reference partition. These predictions are a genuine held-out
subset, **not full inner-OOF coverage of the56,000 outer-training customers**.
Verify prediction SHA,ID hashes,reference fit customers and cached candidate
metrics before reuse.

Split the11,200 head-training examples80:20,stratified,seed151027+fold. Fit initial
preprocessing on the8,960 meta-fit examples only. AdamW lr.0015,weight_decay.01,
batch1024,BCE with bounded correction plus.05*mean(correction²),max100 epochs,
patience12,gradient clip1. Select epoch and alpha using only2,240 meta-validation
examples. Refit encoder/head on all11,200 for the selected epoch count,seed161027+fold.
Epoch0 and alpha0 are valid negative outcomes.

Evaluate on the original14,000 outer-validation customers and30,000 test rows;
reuse the original outer Kumo50,000 context and outer spline56,000 training rows.
The inner44,800/outer50,000 context and reference-population differences are a
limitation and may shift residual behavior. All residual candidates share this
protocol. No outer validation label enters model training,early stopping,
representation fitting or alpha selection.

## Artifacts and decisions

Each candidate produces70,000 aligned OOF rows,KS/AUC,delta KS,300 paired-bootstrap
95% intervals,fold variability/wins,training cost and a30,000-row submission CSV
in sample order. Save per-fold residual.pt,encoder.joblib,selection trace,
source hashes and training/validation indices. Embedding candidates also save
8/16D application embeddings for held-out and test rows,per fold. Axes are learned
separately in each fold and must not be averaged as if their bases were aligned.
Zero-epoch/zero-alpha outputs do not demonstrate useful learned representations.

LATENT_EMBEDDING_INSIGHTS.md. Independent audit replays actual checkpoints,
verifies source Kumo/spline immutability,meta/context disjointness,exact control,
predictions/submission SHA and five-fold test averaging. Also bootstrap embedding
versus linear,not just versus baseline. No automatic model promotion or Kaggle
submission. A small OOF increase alone is not a generalization claim.

trusted_point_in_time=False is inherited. No new DPD/paid fields are constructed.

predictions and exclude retraining,seed and repeated-selection uncertainty.

# Frozen Kumo followup queue

Authorized: all four proposed research directions. Work stays in adit; existing
notebooks and previous submissions are preserved. Start only after the actuarial
batch is COMPLETE and its independent audit is PASS.

## Candidate matrix

| ID | Candidate | Intervention | Matched control |
|---|---|---|---|
| N01 | cre_next_ebm_main | EBM main effects on original spline87; Kumo75/EBM25 | original Kumo75/spline25 |
| N02 | cre_next_ebm_pairs | Same inputs and settings, four prescribed bivariate terms | N01 |
| N03 | cre_next_ebm_act | Add all eleven actuarial features and burden/downside pair | actuarial-all spline; N02 |
| N04 | cre_next_cf_level | Spline87 plus six account level/coverage/projection features | original spline87 |
| N05 | cre_next_cf_predictive | N04 plus six posterior predictive stress features | N04 |
| N06 | cre_next_cf_act | Spline87 plus account levels, predictive stress and actuarial11 | actuarial-all; N05 |
| N07 | cre_next_select64 | Inner-selected64 Kumo inputs; unchanged spline87 | N09 |
| N08 | cre_next_select80 | Inner-selected80 Kumo inputs; unchanged spline87 | N09 |
| N09 | cre_next_select100 | Exact original100 control; existing predictions reused | existing baseline |
| N10 | cre_next_noacc_global | Global thin-input EBM, replaces spline only where account history absent | original baseline |
| N11 | cre_next_noacc_special | Same inputs/gate, train EBM only on no-account training customers | N10 |
| N12 | cre_next_norep_global | Global thin-input EBM, replaces spline only where repayment history absent | original baseline |
| N13 | cre_next_norep_special | Same inputs/gate, train EBM only on no-repayment training customers | N12 |

Every candidate uses the existing five customer-disjoint StratifiedKFold splits,
seed31027. The original Kumo checkpoint is pinned and 100% frozen. Kumo contexts
remain50,000, eight estimators, original generator seeds and logical FP16 chunks.
N07/N08 require ten new Kumo fits in total. Other CV candidates reuse the same
frozen Kumo predictions. At most two CPU and two bounded GPU workers run together;
shared GPU reservations account for other users' memory. No automatic Kaggle submission.

## Mechanisms

Four prescribed EBM pairs: bureau posterior × repayment posterior; installment
burden × income instability; price posterior × burden; basket entropy × repayment
coverage count. N03 also tests burden × account downside. EBM settings are fixed:
interpret-core0.7.8,4 bags,64 main bins,16 interaction bins,learning_rate.03,
min_samples_leaf100,L2=5,max_rounds1800,internal early stopping80 rounds.
EBM is a companion to frozen Kumo, not an independently promoted final model.

Liquidity: use complete account months in the last12 calendar months; require at
least6 measured months and latest month exactly the last completed month. Define
X=(inflows-outflows)/new_installment. This preserves observed inflow/outflow
dependence without assuming two independent marginal processes. Fit target-free
employment priors only on outer-training customers. Normal-Inverse-Gamma prior:
kappa0=3,alpha0=4,beta0=3×robust training within-customer variance. Posterior:
kappa=kappa0+n,mu=(kappa0×mu0+n×mean)/kappa,alpha=alpha0+n/2,
beta=beta0+M2/2+kappa0×n×(mean-mu0)^2/(2×kappa).
Simulate512 posterior predictive three-month paths with common random numbers;
draw shared mean/variance per path and conditional monthly net flows. Add
P(projected balance crosses zero),P(negative end balance),10th percentile minimum
balance,expected maximum liquidity shortfall,predictive SD,posterior mean SD.
Start at last complete month's closing balance. Unobserved decision-month flows
are not known; these are stationary model projections, not observed future cash
flows or calibrated default probabilities. Do not subtract old installments or
ecommerce again from net flow. Missing/insufficient history stays undefined.

Selection: build absolute Spearman.95 blocks using inner-training customers only;
fit a small HistGradientBoosting model on inner training and rank grouped
permutation AUC loss on inner validation (two permutations). Protect core risk
variables and one representative of each information domain. Rank members using
inner-training univariate strength, preserve original column order, and compare
64/80/100 at identical context size. Grouping alone never proves dispensability.
The100-input control is a byte/score consistency control, not another search trial.

Thin-history models: use only static application, declared capacity, bureau,
shopping and price measurements in the companion. Gate by documented absence of
internal history. Absence is not evidence of being new to credit. Global and

Reference: frozen Kumo Large 100 features + spline 87, 75:25 blend;
OOF KS 0.5296876128349908. Five stratified folds, seed 31027, unchanged.
This is continued development on reused validation data, not a new holdout.

1. **Feature ablation:** remove the four domain interactions, the three basket
   composition inputs (30/90-day entropy and category shift), or the three
   basket structure inputs from Kumo separately. Keep the same spline 87 and
   original context/generator seeds. Three experiments.
2. **Nested tuning:** one deterministic stratified 20% inner holdout inside
   each outer training fold. Refit all population references on inner-training
   customers only, and build fresh frozen Kumo predictions for inner validation.
   Grid: spline C {0.01,0.05,0.2}, knots {3,5,7}, spline weight {0.1,0.25,0.4}.
   Select by inner KS, then AUC, then proximity to the original settings.
   Refit the chosen spline on the entire outer-training fold and evaluate once
   on that fold's outer validation. One five-fold experiment; internal trials
   are diagnostics, not full submission experiments.
3. **Context:** repeat the 50,000-row context with sampling seed offsets 1000
   and 2000 while retaining the original model generator seed. Also sample
   50,000 rows stratified jointly by observed training target, internal account
   coverage and repayment coverage, preserving their training proportions.
   Never use validation/test target or match test-population proportions.
   Three experiments; a fixed equal average of the three seed predictions is
   an additional prespecified no-training control.
4. **Financial uncertainty and coverage:** add probability that latent mean
   income is below installment/0.4, plus entropy interacted with absence of
   internal repayments. Fit sigma/noise references on training only. Missing
   or invalid denominators remain missing; zero sigma uses the deterministic
   strict-threshold limit. Test each addition on the spline alone using the
   existing Kumo100, then both additions on both branches. Three experiments.

All backbone weights remain unchanged; there is no neural optimizer/backward.

snapshot provenance remains UNVERIFIED; trusted_point_in_time=False.

chunk budget exactly. Six CPU workers maximum. Check free memory at admission.
Every complete five-fold experiment exports aligned OOF, fold metrics, model
provenance, bootstrap CI, and a separate 30,000-row submission CSV. New public
scores are unknown. No automatic Kaggle submission.

Paired stratified bootstrap: 300 resamples vs the fixed best reference and
foldlocal baseline. These intervals exclude seed/retraining/selection variance.
Report negative results and AUC direction as well as KS. Context seed variance
and fold variance are reported separately. No winner is promoted automatically.

large_latent_reproduction_20261018/PARAL.text:
# Reproduce first fold, then run focused solutions in parallel

The latest user instruction allows improvements after the first reproduced fold,
human fold1 / code fold0. The five-fold reproduction continues independently.
`FIRST_FOLD_REPRODUCTION_PASS.json` requires identical input/context hashes,
maximum prediction difference<=1e-7 for BOTH OOF/test Kumo and spline, and identical
combined KS within1e-12. Bit-exact equality is reported separately. An attempted
manual loader that failed is preserved under `models/manual_loader_attempt` and
is never silently reused. `LOADER_AUDIT.json` identifies the checkpoint stride
difference in the two label embedding tensors; all reruns now use the original
SDK pretrained constructor, matching its meta initialization and assign=True.
That loader change alone did not resolve the mismatch: both attempts generated
identical predictions. The unmodified original evaluator reproduced that same
mismatch under the process memory cap. SDK source inspection found that
`chunk_memory_limit = total_device_memory * process_fraction *
SDM_CHUNK_MEMORY_FRACTION`. The default SDK fraction is0.05, so a0.30 allocation
cap silently shrank operation chunks to30% of the original size. The next rerun
keeps the physical cap and compensates the SDK fraction to preserve the original
logical chunk budget exactly in bytes. `GPU_MEMORY_PROTOCOL.json` records and
asserts that budget; prediction checks still decide whether reproduction passes.

## Predeclared experiments

All solutions use the same five outer folds, seed31027,50,000 training-only context
rows, eight estimators, FP16, estimator batch4, query batch8192 and blend75/25.
No hyperparameter search or outer-validation weight selection is performed.

|Variant|What changes|Compute|
|---|---|---|
|foldlocal|Recompute training-fold category price references, repayment event priors, latent priors/noise, and income-noise estimates; preserve original feature names and recipe|Large GPU + spline CPU|
|price_only|Original57 spline features plus price latent family only|Reuse corrected Large; spline CPU|
|bureau_only|Original57 spline features plus bureau latent family only|Reuse corrected Large; spline CPU|
|income_only|Original57 spline features plus income latent family only|Reuse corrected Large; spline CPU|
|repayment_only|Original57 spline features plus repayment latent family only|Reuse corrected Large; spline CPU|
|no_latent|Original57 spline features; no latent additions|Reuse corrected Large; spline CPU|
|domain_interactions|Four prespecified burden/stability, income/liquidity, bureau/repayment and price/capacity products in spline|Reuse corrected Large; spline CPU|
|temporal|Eight recent-versus-history/capacity/freshness features in BOTH Large and spline|Large GPU + spline CPU|
|basket|Six existing PIT item/basket features absent from original90-column recipe, in BOTH branches|Large GPU + spline CPU|

The corrected Large predictions are shared across CPU ablations because their90
input columns and contexts are identical. Models are not repeatedly inferred for
these ablations. Each variant still saves its own fitted spline, OOF, per-fold
metrics, complete metadata and final30,000-row submission.

## New temporal features

- Completed category-relative log price: mean age0–30 days minus mean30–120 days.
- Log income: last three completed calendar months minus earlier three months.
- Proposed installment / geometric income in last three completed months.
- Log declared income minus recent geometric-income log.
- Latest bureau mean minus posterior historical bureau score.
- Minimum report age /365 times posterior bureau SD.
- Matured late1 and late30 rates: recent90-day due window minus older history;
  each rate uses training-fold historical-event mean with strength24.

## Data safeguards and interpretation

Raw CSV parsing is cached as parquet. Integer customer/order/category codes and
NumPy sufficient statistics avoid repeated sorting of millions of string IDs.
Repayment requires an earlier approved loan and matching customer FK; selected
application is excluded. Bureau requires both report and availability before
cutoff. Accounts require complete months. Completed spending and item composition
are not conflated. Basket features reuse the existing validated PIT cache.

All population/noise/prior parameters are fitted on outer-training customers only.
Income-noise estimation uses consecutive calendar months. Undefined divisions stay
missing; original coverage flags and spline missing indicators remain present.
Tests compare aggregations against pandas and perturb held-out prices to ensure
training reference estimates and training features cannot change.

The original servicing DPD/paid snapshot assumption remains **unverified**. This
is explicitly retained in the original information-set comparison and every
manifest; fold-local corrections do not certify its provenance. No hidden-test
labels or public score feedback choose the new variants. Their public scores are
unknown. Paired300 bootstrap intervals condition on the fitted OOF predictions,
and exclude training-seed/model-selection uncertainty.

## Concurrency

The existing primary GPU lanes retain approximately24GiB process caps each.
Observed Large usage was about16GiB, so an extra research lane runs basket with
a25% device allocation cap, approximately20GiB. It starts only when35% of total
device memory is currently free. The three Large caps sum to85% of device
memory. All preserve the original SDK logical chunk budget independently of the
physical cap. Reproduction uses the comparison lane; corrected Large uses the
main lane; temporal waits for the comparison lane. Basket has a shared variant
RUN.lock and COMPLETE cache, so the main queue later reuses its finished results
instead of fitting it twice. The live original coordinator was already running
when this extra lane was added; `GPU_RESEARCH_QUEUE.json` records its additional
worker. Future coordinator launches include that lane directly.

Two CPU queues run spline ablations while GPU jobs proceed. Conditional EDA
runs separately via `domain_diagnostic.py`. Other users' processes are untouched.
The original notebook/repository is read-only; all writes remain in `adit`.

The original Kumo constructor flags are preserved. All Kumo calls use
inference_mode with no optimizer or backward; checkpoint tensors are checked for
equality after inference. New fits train only the explicitly declared spline
component. This follows the original best recipe rather than introducing an
unrequested fine-tuning change.

large_latent_reproduction_20261018/SELEC.text:
# Select64 overfitting diagnosis

Confirmed user-reported select64 public KS:0.56082,versus preserved original0.56393(delta -0.00311).
This is a real observed regression,but one public score does not establish severe parameter overfitting. Hidden labels and public subset membership are unavailable.

| Recipe | Pooled OOF KS | OOF AUC | Public KS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|Original reproduced recipe|0.52850998|0.84732114|0.56393|
|Kumo100/basket/domain reference|0.52968761|0.84711858|unknown|
|Selected64|0.53079541|0.84707685|0.56082|

## Evidence of weak selection/generalization

Select64 pooled delta versus Kumo100:+0.00110780; paired conditional95% CI[-0.00195012,+0.00356735].
Only3/5 folds win. Mean within-fold KS delta:+0.00016149; AUC delta:-0.00004173.
KS uses a maximum over thresholds; a small improvement at that maximum need not indicate improved ranking across the score distribution.
The public comparison also changes the original Kumo90/spline77/global-reference recipe to Kumo64/spline87/fold-local references with basket/domain additions. The intermediate Kumo100 reference has no recorded public score. The public regression cannot be attributed to pruning alone.
Pooled OOF KS and mean fold KS summarize different comparisons. Their gain difference can reflect cross-fold score alignment; it is not evidence of a known causal mechanism.
At least72 complete70k-OOF candidates were examined in this workspace(70 distinct CSV hashes). Reusing these folds makes the winning score optimistic; the row bootstrap does not correct for winner selection.
## Feature selection and backbone

Kumo weights are100% frozen and audited unchanged. Ordinary gradient-driven Kumo weight overfitting is not supported by this run; context adaptation,feature selection and spline/fusion selection can still generalize poorly.
The inner selector uses a different model(HistGradientBoosting),group permutation AUC with2 repeats,then univariate within-group representatives. Its ranking need not match Kumo conditional feature utility.
Selections share50/64 features across all folds; union70; pairwise Jaccard0.8551â€“0.9104. This is fairly stable and is not by itself proof of a wildly unstable selector.
The removed36 columns change Kumo contextual geometry and information. KS improvement cannot be attributed to reduced overfitting solely because fewer columns were used.
Outer validation IDs were excluded from inner selection. Audit PASS supports this isolation; it does not establish generalization or snapshot availability.
## Drift and validation scope

Fold0 train56k versus test30k: maximum binned feature PSI0.001316 across100 Kumo inputs. See per-feature details; PSI does not test conditional label drift.
Per-fold score drift compares the same fitted estimator on its validation and test rows. Comparing single-fold OOF directly to averaged test scores would confound averaging with drift.
Month slices win7/12 months. They are diagnostics from random OOF,not models trained strictly before each month.
Random customer-disjoint folds do not automatically mismatch test: train/test decision-date distributions must be checked. Existing temporal stress tests baseline/EBM/cashflow,not select64.
Decision dates: train2025-01-01 08:00:00 to2025-12-28 20:59:00; test2025-01-01 08:07:00 to2025-12-28 20:52:00. Per-month train/test fractions are saved separately.
Q4 was previously inspected. A new Q4 result is retrospective development evidence,not an untouched holdout.
Legacy DPD/amount_paid snapshot provenance remains unresolved in both recipes; this comparison cannot certify point-in-time safety.
## Decision

Do not promote select64 based on the highest pooled OOF KS. Preserve the original public-best recipe and the existing100-column reference. Keep select64 as a negative/uncertain result.
Before adding features: evaluate matched100-versus64 under a prespecified temporal refit and repeated context seeds,using the same rows/settings; report paired effects and training cost.
Feature-set budgets should be chosen inside inner validation using the actual frozen-Kumo recipe where feasible. Keep an independent confirmation protocol; do not tune repeatedly against public scores.
Every completed candidate now receives an automated evidence/risk review in OVERFITTING_REVIEW.md and reports/OVERFIT_RISK_REVIEW.csv. Risk levels are operational promotion flags,not probabilities or proven diagnoses.

large_latent_reproduction_20261018/WAVE2.text:
# Domain experiment wave2: locked implementation

Five methods produce nine matched five-fold candidates. Kumo backbone100% frozen;
same checkpoint SHA, seed31027 folds, context seeds2026+fold, eight estimators,
batch4, query8192 and preserved logical SDK chunk budget. Three GPU lanes share
the existing reservation registry and locks; this wave cannot bypass VRAM limits.

1. Spending decomposition:10 inputs. Recent7 versus preceding23 days separates
order intensity, units/order, unit cost, within-category unit-price change and
quantity-mix divergence. The exact spending factorization is checked. Personal
burst/silence features use Gamma-Poisson predictive tails from prior150 days,
fixed Jeffreys shape0.5, only with180-day observed event span. This span is not
proof of continuous capture. Spending uses completed orders/items only.
2. Recovery:13 inputs. Monthly states combine surplus after the proposed
installment with minimum balance versus installment. State3 means both stressed,
state0 both adequate. Transitions use consecutive completed months; entry uses
nonstress-transition exposure, persistence/recovery use stress-transition exposure.
Means shrink toward training-only population rates with prior strength10.
Duration excludes episodes whose beginning is unobserved, resets at gaps, and
marks unfinished episodes as censored. Missing account inputs are excluded.
3. Excess coupling:4 inputs. Actual normalized due-window spending minus mean
from shifts{-28,-14,-7,+7,+14,+28}days, with valid-count, variability and safe z.
Union exposure is recomputed and clipped to90days for each control. Original
coupling must reproduce the previous feature. No DPD/paid fields are read.
4. Context enrichment:28000 unique rows,20% and25% default. Contexts come only
from outer training, without replacement. Each gets raw and prior-odds-corrected
submission controls. Prior correction must preserve raw-expert KS; it may alter
the ordering of a spline mixture, which is reported separately. Label-shift
correction assumes usable probability scales and within-class random sampling.
5. Pairwise adapter: bounded linear logit correction with L2=0.01 and bound0.5.
Four nearest negative examples per positive are matched within training income
quartile/account coverage, using genuine inner-OOF baseline-logit proximity.
A BCE head with identical inputs, preprocessing and correction capacity is its
control. Both use the global28000 expert, with population references fitted
separately inside the existing two inner folds. No outer targets fit the head.

The first three methods use reference100 tabular columns plus their own family,
50000 contexts and the unchanged spline87 branch. Head/context comparisons use
the matched28000 expert. All candidates retain75:25 expert/spline fusion.
Every completed candidate exports70000-row OOF, KS/AUC, fold variability, paired
bootstrap CI versus the reference, and a30000-row submission. Final audit adds
paired context/global28 and pairwise/BCE comparisons. Public scores are unknown.
Inherited servicing snapshot provenance remains UNVERIFIED; no result is
certified fully point-in-time. Reused CV remains development evidence.

Runtime: scripts/wave2_supervisor.py; CPU source builder: wave2_features.py;
GPU jobs: wave2_gpu.py; CPU adapters: wave2_heads.py. A standalone coordinator
adopts early-launched workers and records reports/WAVE2_PIPELINE.json,
reports/WAVE2_EXPERIMENTS.csv and the shared EXPERIMENT_LOG.csv.
